sanskrit: dharmaśāstre sadā nindā sādhudrohī nirantaramtvayā kṛtāni tantrāṇi jīvoddhāraṇahetaveviprā bhaviṣyantīti pūrveṇānvayaḥprītijanakavyāpāraḥ tābhyāṃ hīnāḥkathitā bahavo nyāsāḥ sṛṣṭisthityādilakṣaṇāḥpaśuvīradivyabhāvā devatā mantrasiddhidāḥlatāsādhanakarmāṇi tvayoktāni sahasraśaḥkalau na paśubhāvo'sti divyabhāvaḥ kuto bhavetna śūdradarśanaṃ kuryyāt manasā na striyaṃ smaretdvandvātīto vītarāgaḥ sarvabhūtasamaḥ kṣamīsṛṣṭisthityādisvarūpāḥmuktapadmāsanādeḥ saṃgrahaḥmṛtaśarīrāsanam || 52dvābhyām | patramityādi | āharet ānayetnidrālasyaprasaktānāṃ bhāvaśuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavetetāni pañcatattvāni tvayā proktāni śaṅkaralobhāttatra patiṣyanti na kariṣyanti sādhanambhaviṣyanti madonmattā hitāhitavivarjitāḥtadvānpratipādayitumāha | kalītyādimadyamāṃsādīni pañcatattvāni ca tvayā proktānītyanvayaḥkalijā iti | tatra madyādipañcatattveṣuindriyāṇāmiti | madhu madyamna kariṣyanti te mattāḥ pāpāyonivicāraṇamśaktihīnā buddhihīnā bhūtvā ca vikalendriyāḥ

sanskrit: yatsādhane kuleśāni taṃ vinā ko'nyamāśrayetjīvanistāropāyapraśno nāma dvitīyollāsaḥtaṃ paramātmānamvaktā tvaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ sādhanasya cayasyopāsanato martyo bhuktiṃ muktiñca vindatikiṃ tasya sādhanaṃ deva mantraḥ ko vā prakīrtitaḥtattvena śrotumicchāmi kṛpayā kathaya prabhotava snehena vakṣyāmi mama prāṇādhikaṃ paramtathā tattvasvarūpeṇa lakṣaṇairvā maheśvariasattrilokīsadbhānaṃ svarūpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtamdvandvātītairnirvikalpairdehātmādhyāsavarjitaiḥyāthārthye iti kośaḥ | rahasyaṃ guhyampadārtho yaiḥ tāni lakṣaṇāni taiḥ | karaṇe lyuṭsadvadjñānaṃ yasmāt tadbrahmaṇaḥ svarūpaṃ smṛtamyasmin sarvāṇi līyante jñeyaṃ tadbrahma lakṣaṇaiḥlakṣaṇairāptumicchūnāṃ vihitaṃ tatra sādhanamtatrādau kathayāmyādye mantroddhāraṃ maheśituḥyogāḥ samyagdarśanādayo yeṣāṃ taiḥ samādhiyogairjanaiḥtaṭasthairetairlakṣaṇairjñeyaṃ veditavyamsādhanaṃ vihitammaheśiturmaheśvarasya mantroddhāraṃ kathayāmiekaṃ padānte brahmeti mantroddhāraḥ prakīrtitaḥtārahīnena deveśi ṣaḍvarṇo'yaṃ manurbhavetnātra siddhādyapekṣā'sti nārimitrādidūṣaṇamsarvathā siddhamantro'yaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā

sanskrit: kuladharma iti bhāvaḥvipattīnāṃ rujāṃ rogāṇāṃ ca nāśinīsetyadhyāhāralabhye || 106na jāne pañcatatvānāṃ sevanāt kiṃ phalaṃ bhavetnṝṇāṃ vināśayet sarvaṃ buddhimāyuryaśo dhanambuddhirvinaśyati prāyo lokānāṃ mattacetasāmsvāniṣṭaṃ ca parāniṣṭaṃ jāyate'smāt pade padeatyāsaktajanān kāyadhanadaṇḍena śodhayetmadirāṃ pibanti te kṣitau pṛthivyāmamartyā devā eva bhavantibuddhimāyuryaśodhanamityādi sarvaṃ vināśayetbuddhiḥ prāyo vinaśyatikāyadhanadaṇḍena śodhayet || 112deśakālavibhedena buddhibhraṃśo bhavennṝṇāmskhaladvākpāṇipāddṛgbhiratipānaṃ vicārayetdevatāgurumaryādollaṅghino bhayarūpiṇaḥdahejjihvāṃ haredarthān tāḍayettaṃ ca pārthivaḥtamugraṃ yātayedrājā draviṇaṃ cāharettataḥvicaladbhirvacohastapādanetrairatipānaṃ vicārayet vilakṣayettamugraṃ raudraṃ rājā yātayet tato draviṇaṃ ca āharetdhanādānena taṃ śāsyāt prajāprītikaro nṛpaḥpaśureva sa mantavyaḥ kuladharmabahiṣkṛtaḥtyājyo bhavati kaulānāṃ daṇḍanīyo'pi bhūbhṛtaḥśudhyeyurbhāryayā sārdhaṃ pañcāhaṃ kaṇabhojanātbhuktvā'pyaśodhitaṃ māṃsamupavāsadvayaṃ caretmattaṃ prajāprītikaro nṛpo dhanādānena śāsyāt

sanskrit: paśureva mantavyaḥ yataḥ sa kuladharmādbahiṣkṛtaḥkaulānāṃ tyājyo bhūbhṛto daṇḍanīyo'pi bhavatibhāryayā sārdhaṃ pañcāhaṃ kaṇabhojanācchudhyeyuḥupavāsadvayaṃ caret kuryātavaidhaṃ pañcamaṃ kurvan rājño daṇḍena śudhyatiupoṣya pakṣaṃ śuddhaḥ syāt prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtamattvā śudhyennaraḥ pāpādupavāsaistribhiḥ priyekhādannannaṃ viśuddhaḥ syāt pakṣamekamupoṣitaḥśudhyenmāsopavāsenā'jñānāt pakṣopavāsataḥśudhyatiprāyaścittaṃ smṛtamnarastribhirupavāsaiḥ pāpāt śudhyetpakṣamekamupoṣitaḥ san viśuddhaḥ syātdinatrayopavāsena viśuddhaḥ syānmamājñayāvīrahastārpitaṃ vāpi tadaśnannaiva pāpabhākniṣiddhenā'danenāpi rakṣan prāṇānna pātakīalakṣite'pi duṣyāṇāṃ bhakṣyadoṣo na vidyatebhuñjīta tadā pakṣopavāsataḥ śudhyetpāpabhāk naiva bhavetna hanyāddevatārthe'pi hatvā ca pātakī bhavetajñānādācaredardhaṃ vrataṃ śaṅkaraśāsanātna kṣārayogaṃ vasane yāvanna vratamācaretmāsaṃ bhaikṣānnamaśnīyāt kṛcchravratamidaṃ śiveteṣāmavijñāne'pi bhakṣyadoṣo na vidyatepātakī bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaṅkaraśāsanādardhaṃ vratamācaret kuryātvasane vastre kṣārayogaṃ ca na kuryātbhojayitvā vimuktaḥ syād jñānagovadhapātakātbāhujādyā viśudhyeyuḥ pādanyūnakramāt priyeupavāsaistribhiḥ śudhyenmānavaḥ kṛtakilviṣaḥmayūraśukahaṃsāṃśca sajyotiraśanaṃ tyajetjñānagovadhapātakājjano vimuktaḥ syātpādapādanyūnaṃ vrataṃ karaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥmānavastribhirupavāsaiḥ śudhyetjyotirnā bhāskare'gnau ca klībaṃ bhadyota dṛṣṭiṣviti rudraḥnirasthijīvino hatvā manastāpena śuddhyatina pāpārho bhaveddevi rājño dharmaḥ sanātanaḥkṛtāyāṃ vaidhahiṃsāyāṃ naraḥ pāpairna lipyateaśucau devatāsparśe gāyatrījapamācaretnirasthijīvino'sthirahitajantūn hatvā manastāpena śudhyatikṛtāyāṃ satyāṃ naraḥ pāpairna lipyatenindannetān vadan krūraṃ śudhyet pañcopavāsataḥsārdhadvayopavāsena mukto bhavati pātakātniṣiddhakaulikācāraṃ deśaṃ śāstramapi tyajetkuladharmātpatedbhūyaḥ śudhyet pūrṇābhiṣekataḥaśucāvaśauce devatāsparśe ca gāyatrījapamācaretśudhyetmānavastyajetupavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścitte vidhīyatemānavaḥ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ na bhraśyedupavāsataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadā pratyupavāsañca bhojayeddvādaśa dvijānayuktaṃ karma kurvāṇo manastāpairviśudhyatipūrṇābhiṣekataḥ śudhyetprāyaścitte sa vidhīyate kriyatepatet | ekāñjalitoyapānādupavāso na vinaśyediti tattvamdvādaśa dvijān brāhmaṇān bhojayetnaro manastāpairviśudhyatinaśyanti japanāddevyāḥ sāvitryāḥ kaulabhojanātyoṣitāṃ tu viśeṣo'yaṃ patireko mahāguruḥsvarṇadānena pūtāḥ syurdaive paitrye'dhikāriṇaḥgṛhaṃ viśodhayeddhomairvyāhṛtyā śatasaṃkhyakaiḥbhojanācca naśyantiyoṣitāṃ strīṇāntu patireko mahāguruḥ smṛto'yaṃ viśeṣaḥdaive paitrye ca karmaṇi adhikāriṇaḥ syuḥśatasaṃkhyakairhomairviśodhayetuddhṛtya kuṇapaṃ tebhyastatastān pariśodhayetpūrṇaistrisaptakumbhaistān plāvayediti śodhanamsapaṅkaṃ salilaṃ sarvamuddhṛtyāplāvayettu tānśatakumbhajaloddhārairabhiṣekeṇa śodhayetapeyasalilāsteṣāṃ pratiṣṭhāmapi nācaretpariśodhayetśodhanaṃ ayaṃ śodhanaprakāraḥtānāplāvayetśodhayetdinamekaṃ nirāhāraḥ śudhyet pañcāmṛtāśanāt

sanskrit: dūṣakaṃ kuladharmāṇāṃ madyapāñca kulastriyampaśyan sūryaṃ smaran viṣṇuṃ sacelaḥ snānamācaretnīcavṛttiṃ caranto'pi śudhyeyustridinavratātsmarannaraḥ sacelaḥ savastraḥ snānamācaret || 163kurvanto dvijātayo brāhmaṇāstridinavratāt śudhyeyuḥvāritārthapravaktā'pi pañcāhamaśanaṃ tyajettathaiva kulaśāstrāṇi śudhyedekopavāsataḥkūṭenārthaṃ kalpayantaḥ patitā yāntyadhogatimsmṛtamdoṣabhāgitvamiti dhvanitamihāmutrārthadaṃ dharmyaṃ pāvanaṃ hitakārakamyān rakṣan pravidanrājā svacchandaṃ pālayet prajāḥmithaste vivadiṣyanti gurusvajanabandhubhiḥpāpāśrayā bhaviṣyanti hiṃsayā ca jihīrṣayāniyojyate yamāśritya na bhraśyeyuḥ śubhānnarāḥsvairaṃ prajāḥ pālayedrakṣettathaiva vibhajeddāyān nṛṇāṃ sambandhabhedataḥtatraudvāhikasambandhādaparo balavattaraḥadha ūrdhvakramādatra pumān mukhyataraḥ smṛtaḥvibhaktān kuryāt | dāyo dāne dhane puṃsi vācyaliṅgastu dātarijñeyaḥanena vidhinā dhīrā vibhajeyuḥ kramāddhanambhāryāyāmapi dāyārhaḥ putra eva na cāparaḥjyeṣṭhe rājyādhikāritvaṃ tattu vaṃśānusārataḥmukhyataraḥ pradhānataraḥ smṛtaḥ

sanskrit: kramādvibhajeyurvaṇṭayeyuḥpituścordhvabhavatvenā'jyāyastvāddāyārhatvaṃ netyarthaḥtasmin sthite vibhāgārhaṃ na bhavet paitṛkaṃ vasutebhyastaddhanamāhṛtya pitṝṇaṃ dāpayennṛpaḥṛṇenāpi tathā baddhaḥ svayameva na cāparaḥdraviṇaṃ vibhajya sarve gṛhṇīyuriti bhāvaḥvaṇṭanayogyaṃ na bhavetnṛpo rājā pitṝṇaṃ tātasambandhi ṛṇaṃ tairdāpayetna cāparastadanyaḥ kaścana baddho bhavetaṃśinaḥ prāptumarhanti svaṃ svamaṃśaṃ vibhāgataḥteṣāmasammatau rājā samadṛṣṭyāṃśamācaretmūlyaṃ vā tadupasvatvamaṃśināṃ vibhajennṛpaḥpunarvibhajya taddravyamaprāptāṃśāya dāpayetlabdhumarhanti yogyā bhavantiśeṣe iti ṣaṣṭhīpunarvivādayaṃstatra śāsyo bhavati bhūbhṛtaḥpautra eva dhanārhaḥ syādadhastājjanmagauravātjanmataḥ sannikarṣeṇa pitaivā'sya dhanaṃ haretmṛtasya pautro dhanabhāk yato mukhyataraḥ pumāndravyaṃ vibhajya nṛpo dāyādairdāpayetgauravādgurutvāddhetoḥ pautra eva dhanārho dhanayogyaḥ syātato'tra gīyate lokaiḥ putrarūpaḥ svayaṃ pitāaputrasya haredrikthaṃ patyurdehārdhahāriṇīnaiva dātuṃ na vikretuṃ samarthā svadhanaṃ vināputrarūpa iti gīyate śabdyate

sanskrit: rikthamṛkthaṃ dhanaṃ vasvityamaraḥvinā | svakīyaṃ tu dhanaṃ dātuṃ vikretuṃ śaknotītyarthaḥsvakṛtyopārjitaṃ yacca strīdhanaṃ tat prakīrtitamtadāsannataro rikthamadha ūrdhvakramādharettadabhāve pitṛbandhostiṣṭhantī dāyamarhatilabhate jīvanaṃ mātraṃ bharturvibhavahāriṇaḥjano haret | etattu sāmānyata uktaṃ viśeṣatastvagre vakṣyatebhajeran svāmino vittaṃ samāṃśena śucismitepunaḥ svāmipadaṃ gatvā dhanaṃ duhitaraṃ vrajettanmṛtau svāminaṃ prāpya śvaśurāttatsutāmiyātityamaraḥsamāṃśena tulyabhāgena bhajeran severangacchediti sūcayāñcakretasyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ putreṇa bhartrā śvaśuragambhavetjananyapi tathā'pnoti patihīnā bhavedyadimṛtau jananyāstaṃ prāpya pitrā gacchedvimātaramyenaivā'dhastanaṃ prāptaṃ tenaivordhvaṃ tadā vrajetetacca bhartṛduhitrādibhrātrīyaparyantābhāve boddhavyamtatputrāṇāñcā'sattve boddhavyampatihīnā svāmirahitā bhavet tadā tajjananyapyāpnotiprāpya pitrā vimātaraṃ gacchetpatyau sthite'napatyāyā mṛtau pitṛvyamāśrayetataḥ satyāṃ sodarāyāṃ vaimātreyo dhanaṃ haretvaimātreyagataṃ vittaṃ vaimātreyānvayo bhajettadapatyagāmitaivetyasūsucat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaginyāṃ satyāmapi vaimātreyo vimātṛjo dhanaṃ haretvaimātreyānvayo vimātṛjasantatirbhajet sevetadhanaṃ pitṛgatatvena vibhajetāṃ samāṃśinauyatra yadbādhitaṃ vittaṃ tanmṛtāvaparaṃ vrajetudvāhayantyo'nūḍhāṃ tu pituḥ sādhāraṇairdhanaiḥanyattu draviṇaṃ yasmādāptaṃ tatpadamāśrayetgṛhṇīyātāmityarthaḥtuśabdena vivāhyamānā'pi pitṛdravyaṃ vibhajetpuṇyantu tadupasvatvairna śaktā dānavikrayepitāmahagataṃ rikthaṃ tatputreṇa snuṣāṃ vrajetadhobhavānāṃ mukhyatvāt bhrātaiva dhanabhāg bhavetyasmājjanādāptaṃ labdhaṃ tatpadamāśrayedbhajetteṣāṃ dāne vikraye ca śaktā samarthā na bhavetpitāmahasyātmajena snuṣāṃ putrapatnīṃ vrajetbhajedityarthaḥdhanaṃ pitṛpadaṃ gatvā prayāturbhrātaraṃ bhajetduhitrapatyaṃ dhanabhāg dhanaṃ yasmādadhomukhampuṃso mukhyataratvena dhanahārī bhavet pitāpretasya dhanahārī syāt pituḥ sambandhagauravātsyādato duhitrapatyameva dhanabhāg bhavetdhanahārī syātsvārthe'ṇato'tra sannikṛṣṭo'pi mātulo nāpnuyāddhanampitāmahasya draviṇāt svapiturdāyamarhatipitāmahadhanaṃ saumyā hareccenmṛtamātṛkā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vitte pitṛgate devi pautrī tatrā'dhikāriṇīdraviṇāt dravyāt svapiturdāyaṃ prāptumarhatigṛhṇīyātūrdhvagāmidhane śreṣṭhaḥ pumānūrdhvodbhavo bhavetpretasya vibhavaṃ hartuṃ naiva śaknoti tatpitāpūrvoktavidhinā rikthaṃ mātāmahakulaṃ bhajetadha ūrdhvakrameṇaivaṃ pumāṃsaṃ striyamāśrayetadhastājjanmagauravāt pautrī tatra pitṛgate vitte'dhikāriṇī syātśreṣṭho bhavetyathākramaṃ tā eva pretadhanaṃ hartuṃ śaknuvantītyarthaḥmātāmahakulaṃ bhajet sevetamṛtasya śaivītanayo na piturdāyabhāg bhavetgrāsamācchādanaṃ bhadre svaḥprayāturyathā dhanamsaumyāñcennādhikāro'syāḥ pitrādīnāṃ dhane priyeyathāvibhavaṃ grāsamācchādanaṃ ca labheran prāpnuyuḥnumāgamaśchāndasaḥkrodhādvā lobhato vāpi sa bhavellokagarhitaḥhareyuḥ kramato vittaṃ mṛtasya śivaśāsanātsodakā daśamāntāḥ syustataḥ kevalagotrajāḥyaḥ sa pitā lokagarhito lokanindito bhavettadabhāve vedādhyāpakaḥ tadasattve tu rājā cetikarmaṇyadhikaraṇe ceti karmaṇi pañcamīavibhaktavidhānena bhajeraṃstaddhanaṃ punaḥmṛte'pi tasya dāyādāstādṛgvibhavabhāginaḥdadyuḥ piṇḍaṃ ta evā'sya śaivabhāryāsutaṃ vinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: p. 37) tato dhyānaṃ prakurvīta sādhakābhīṣṭasādhanamsakalabhuvanabījaṃ brahma caitanyamīḍetata ityādināpūjayet parayā bhaktyā brahmasāyujyahetavenaivedyaṃ toyatattvena pradadyāt paramātmanesamarpya brahmaṇe paścādvahiḥpūjāṃ samārabhetvastrālaṅkaraṇādīni bhakṣyapeyāni yāni canimīlya netre matimānarpayet paramātmanebrahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhināsakalabhuvanabījaṃ samastasya bhuvanasya kāraṇamgandhamityādinā || 51tajjapaṃ brahmasāt kṛtvā stotrañca kavacaṃ paṭhetyat śrutvā sādhako devi brahmasāyujyamaśnutenamo brahmaṇe vyāpine nirguṇāyabrahmaiva gantavyaṃ prāptavyaṃ na tu phalāntaramityarthaḥbrahmasāt brahmādhīnamstotramiti | brahmasāyujyamaśnute brahmatvaṃ prāpnotisattvādiguṇarahitāyatvamekaṃ paraṃ niścalaṃ nirvikalpampareṣāṃ paraṃ rakṣakaṃ rakṣakāṇāmjagadbhāsakādhīśa pāyādapāyātśreṣṭham | nirvikalpaṃ nānāvidhakalpanāśūnyampareṣāṃ śreṣṭhānāmapibhaktibuddhyādiviśleṣātbhavāmbhodhipotaṃ śaraṇyaṃ vrajāmaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhanabhāgitvasambandhāt trirātraṃ vihitaṃ tathāpunaravibhaktavidhānena dāyādā bhajeranmṛte'pi maraṇe'pi te dāyādāstādṛgvibhavabhāgino bhaveyuḥcopalakṣaṇamśravaṇāccheṣadivasairviśuddhyeyurdvijādayaḥpūrṇe trirātraṃ vihitaṃ na cet saṃvatsarāt paramtrirātramaśuciḥ putrastathā bhartuḥ pativratāvihitam | lokaḥ syādbhuvane jane ityamaraḥtasmāt | karaṇādhikaraṇayośca ityadhikaraṇe lyuṭmaraṇaviṣayakamidaṃ vacanamgurvaśaucena martyānāṃ śuddhistatra vidhīyatevyāpyavyāpakayormadhye garīyo vyāpakaṃ smṛtampūrvāśaucena śuddhiḥ syādaghavṛddhyā dinadvayamstrī trirātramaśuciḥ syātmartyānāṃ śuddhirvidhīyategurutaraṃ smṛtamtatrāpyevamevāvagantavyamjātepariṇaye pitrormṛtau tryahamudāhṛtamtathā gṛhītṛgotreṇa dattaputrasya gotritāsvagotranāmānyullikhya saṃskuryāt svajanaiḥ sahatryahaṃ tridinamaśaucamudāhṛtamgotritā gotravattā syātsaṃskāraṃ kuryātādātrordattake tadvadyato'sya pitarau hi taupañcavarṣādhiko bālo dattako na praśasyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: utpādakaḥ pitṛvyaḥ syāt sarvakarmasu kālikesaṃrakṣenniyamāṃstasya tadbandhūn paritoṣayetsyātāmatastaddhana piṇḍayostasyā'dhikāritetyarthaḥbāloḥ asau dattako na praśasyatenā'śaucaṃ maraṇe teṣāṃ naiva dāyādhikāritāmahāpātakināñcāpi mṛtau nā'śaucamācaretpālayedrakṣayedrājā yāvaddvādaśavatsarambandhūnapi paritoṣayetkuryātrakṣayettrirātrānte tatsutādyaiḥ pretatvaṃ parimocayetvibhajya nṛpatirdadyādanyathā pātakī bhavettasyaiva nṛpatiḥ pātā yato bhūpaḥ prajāprabhuḥtasyaiva dārāḥ putrāśca dhanaṃ tasyaiva nānyathāteṣāṃ pretatvañca taireva parimocayetpātakī bhavetbhavet | nisvastu durvidho dīno daridro durgato'pi saḥ ityamaraḥsvajanāyā'thavā'nyasmai dāyādānumatiṃ vināasthāvaraṃ paitṛkaṃ ca svecchayā dātumarhatijanake ca jananyāṃ vā bhrātaryevaṃ svasaryapiasthāvaraṃ paitṛkañca dātuṃ sarvaṃ kṣamo bhavetetatsarvamanyathā na bhavetpādasya pūraṇe'pyuktaṃ navasvartheṣu cāvyayamdātumarhatipuṃsā tadanyathā kartuṃ putrādyairnaiva śakyate

sanskrit: na prabhuḥ punarādātuṃ dharmo hyasya yataḥ prabhuḥsvayaṃ vā tatpratinidhirdharmārthaṃ viniyojayetyāvat | tat dhanaṃ putrādyairanyathākartuṃ naiva śakyatedhanasya | hīti niścitau | dharmaḥ prabhuḥ svāmīmukhyasyābhāve tatsadṛśo ya upādīyate sa pratinidhiḥdadyāt snehena taccānyo nānyathā kartumarhatidadātyanyaiśca dāyādaiḥ pratiroddhuṃ na śakyatepitrye samāṃśā dāyādā na lābhārhā vinā'rjakamdāyādānāṃ taddhanebhya uddhartā dvyaṃśamarhatitadā'nyairdāyādaiḥ pratiroddhuṃ vārayituṃ na śakyatelābhārhāstu na syuḥ | kintvarjaka evaiko lābhārha ityarthaḥśarīrantu pituryasmāt kinna syāt paitṛkaṃ vasusarvaṃ tat pitṛsaṃkrāntaṃ tadā svopārjitaṃ kutaḥsvopārjitaṃ tadeva syāt sa tatsvāmī na cāparaḥlabhanta ityarthaḥpaitṛkameva bhavetdhanasya prabhurna cāparo'rjakabhinnaḥ vāmīmātāmahān kareṇāpi praharannaiva dāyabhākhatānāmanyadāyādā bhaveyurdhanabhāginaḥyāvajjivanamarhanti na te syurdāyabhāginaḥnṛpastatsvāmine prāptrā dāpayet suvicārayandāyabhāgitvaṃ na bhavediti sūcitamhanturbhinnā dāyādā dhanabhāgino bhaveyuḥna syuḥprāptā tatra bhavet svāmī daśamāṃśaṃ nṛpe'rpayet

sanskrit: yaḥ paṭhet prayato bhūtvā brahmasāyujyamāpnuyātśrāvayedbodhayet prājño brahmaniṣṭhān svabāndhavānpaṭhanāddhāraṇād yasya brahmajño jāyate dhruvamkaṇṭhaṃ pātu jagatpātā vadanaṃ sarvadṛgvibhuḥsarvāṅgaṃ sarvadā pātu paraṃ brahma sanātanamjagadāśrayabhūtam | nirālambam āśrayaśūnyampañcaratnamityādinā | prayataḥ pavitraḥ || adaḥ stotram || 64paṭhitavyamatastadabhidhātumupakramate itīticaitanyarūpaḥ || 67caturvargaphalāvāptyai viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥsa brahmajñānamāsādya sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavetkaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāho sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetdadyāt priyāya śiṣyāya gurubhaktāya dhīmatepaṭhitvā stotrakavacaṃ praṇamet sādhakāgraṇīḥnirguṇāya namastubhyaṃ sadrūpāya namo namaḥārādhane pareśasya bhāvaśuddhirvidhīyatemahāprasādaṃ svīkuryād brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥsarvatra sarvakāleṣu sādhayed brahmasādhanampūjayet paramātmānaṃ sadā nirmalamānasaḥdīyate parameśāya tadeva pāvanaṃ mahatparabrahmārpite dravye spṛṣṭāspṛṣṭaṃ na vidyateārādhana ityādi | bhāvaśuddhirantaḥkaraṇaśuddhatvamśālagrāmaśilādau || 79sādhako brahmasāt kṛtvā bhuñjīyāt svajanaiḥ sahana kālaniyamo'pyatra śaucāśaucaṃ tathaiva ca

sanskrit: tathā pūjitadevebhyo dattvā karma samāpayetanenaiva grahāṇāñca yajño'pi vihitaḥ priyesaṅkalpānantaraṃ kāryaṃ vāstvarcanamiti kramaḥgrahāṇāṃ yantramantrau ca dhyānaṃ prāgeva kīrtitamatha prastutakṛtyānāmucyate kūpasaṃskriyāiṣṭvā pūjayitvā || 146ācarya vidhāyatasmai vāstudaityāyamaṇḍale kalaśe vāpi śālagrāme yathāmatiśivo durgā grahāścāpi pūjyā dikpatayastathāprādhānyaṃ varuṇasyātra sa hi pūjyo viśeṣataḥvidhivat saṃskṛte vahnau vāruṇaṃ homamācaretpūrṇāhutyantakṛtyena homakarma samāpayetuktaprokṣaṇamantreṇa prokṣayet kūpamuttamamsarvabhūtaprīṇanāyotsṛjet kūpajalāśayamsuprīyantāṃ sarvabhūtā nabhobhūtoyavāsinaḥtṛpyantu sarvabhūtāni snānapānāvagāhanaiḥye ca kecidvipadyante svasvakarmavipākataḥkūpasaṃskārakramamevāha saṃkalpamityādibhiḥ || 154tatastu dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā kṛtaśāntyādikakriyaḥjalāśayapratiṣṭhāsu sarvatraiṣa kramaḥ śivetaḍāgādau ca kartavyā nāgastambhajalecarāḥkāryā dhātumayāścaite kartṛvittānusārataḥrājatau makarau kūrmamithunaṃ tāmrarintikamsāgarañca samutsṛjya prārthayannāgamarcayet

sanskrit: kartavyāḥityapekṣāyāmāha mīnamaṇḍūketyādinākulīraḥ karkaṭaḥ śaṅkhaḥ pāthasāṃ rakṣakā imesmṛtvā praṇavagāyatryau ghaṭamadhye viniḥkṣipettatrottiṣṭhati yo nāgastaṃ kuryāttoyarakṣakamsaralaṃ dārujaṃ tailairukṣitañca haridrayātatra hrīśrīkṣamāśāntisahitaṃ nāgamarcayetnāgāḥ pāthasāṃ jalānāṃ rakṣakā bhavantītyanvayaḥghaṭamadhye viniḥkṣipetuttiṣṭhati taṃ nāgaṃ toyarakṣakaṃ kuryāthrīśrīkṣamāśāntisahitaṃ nāgamarcayet || 173stambhamenamadhiṣṭhāya jalarakṣāṃ kuruṣva mesamāropya taḍāgañca kartā kuryāt pradakṣiṇamtajjalaṃ tatra niḥkṣipya śiṣṭaṃ karma samāpayetvāstvādivasupūjāntaṃ paitraṃ karma ca kūpavatprājāpatyañca havanaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥjalarakṣāṃ kuruṣvaṣaṣṭyā vā ityanenāvyayībhāvaḥtatra taḍāge niḥkṣipya śiṣṭamavaśeṣaṃ karma samāpayetatra gṛhasaṃskāreīśānābhimukho bhūtvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥasmākaṃ śubhavāsāya sarvathā sukhado bhavaviprān kulīnān dīnāṃśca bhojayedātmaśaktitaḥdevatrākṛtagehasya vidhānaṃ śṛṇu śailajedevatāsannidhiṃ gatvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥ

sanskrit: āgatya janmasāphalyaṃ kuru me karuṇānidhebhūtvā vihitāñjaliḥ san gṛhaṃ prārthayetdevatādhīnakṛtagṛhasya dānasya vidhānaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇuvihitāñjaliḥ san devatāṃ prārthayetyat prārthayettadāha uttiṣṭhetyādināupasthāpya gṛhadvāri purato vāhanaṃ nyasetropayenmandireśāne sapatākaṃ dhvajaṃ sudhīḥśobhayitvā gṛhaṃ samyak chādayeddivyavāsasāsnāpayedvihitairdravyaistatkramaṃ vacmi te śṛṇudugdhena snāpayāmi tvāṃ māteva paripālayadadhnā tvāṃ snāpayāmyadya bhavatāpaharo bhavasthāpayetsapatākaṃ patākāsahitaṃ dhvajaṃ ropayet || 187dravyairdevasnāpanasya kramamdevaṃ snāpayetmadhunā snāpitaḥ prīto māmānandamayaṃ kurusnānaṃ te kalpayāmīśa māmarogaṃ sadā kurudeveśa śarkarātoyaiḥ snāto me yaccha vāñchitamnārikelodakaiḥ snānaṃ kalpayāmi namo'stu tekuru iti samuccaran kartā madhunā devaṃ snāpayetāyuḥśukravardhakena tejasā tejovardhakenaiti ca samudīrayan kartā śarkarātoyairdevaṃ snāpayetp. 429) gāyatryā mūlamantreṇa snāpayedikṣujaiḥ rasaiḥsusnāto bhava suprīto bhuktimuktī prayaccha megṛhābhyantaramānīya sthāpayedāsanopari

sanskrit: śālagrāmaśilāyāṃ vā snāpayitvā prapūjayetiti samuccaran kartā nārikelajalairdevaṃ snāpayetkāśmīram kuṅkumamgṛhābhyantaramānīya ca jagatpatiṃ devamāsanopari sthāpayetprapūjayetaṣṭabhiḥ kalaśairyadvā pañcabhiḥ saptabhiryathāsarvatrāgamakṛtyeṣu sa eva vihito ghaṭaḥtatropacārān vakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi parātparemadhuparkastathācamyaṃ snānīyaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇedevārcanāsu nirdiṣṭā upacārāśca ṣoḍaśagandhādipañcakaṃ caite upacārā daśa smṛtāḥpañcopacārāḥ kathitā devatāyāḥ prapūjanesnāpayet || 200mahādevam mahāntaṃ devam | tatra devayajanesampūjya gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ dravyākhyānaṃ samullikhetsacaturthīṃ samuccārya tyāgārthaṃ vacanaṃ paṭhetanena vidhinā vidvān dravyaṃ dadyāddivaukasearpaṇaṃ kāraṇādīnāṃ sarvameva pradarśitamāsanādyupacārāṇāṃ pradāne viniyojayetkalpayāmyupaveśārthamāsanaṃ te namo namaḥnamo namo'stu anena mantreṇa devāyā'sanaṃ dadyātkṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā svāgataṃ prārthayettataḥsusvāgataṃ svāgataṃ me tasmai te paramātmanesvāgataṃ yattvayā tanme tapasāṃ phalamāgatamvihitaṃ pādyamādāya mantramenamudīrayet

sanskrit: mantreṇa devāya vastre dadyāt || 228mantramāha viśvābharaṇa bhūtāyetitasmai parātmane tubhyaṃ paramaṃ gandhamarpayemayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā puṣpametat pragṛhyatāmāghreyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhūpo ghrāṇāya te'rpyatesabāhyābhyantarajyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatāmnivedayāmi bhaktyedaṃ juṣāṇa parameśvarasarvatṛptikaraṃ svacchamarpayāmi namo'stu tetāmbūlaṃ punarācamyaṃ dattvā vandanamācaretgandhaṃ dadyātpuṣpamityādinā mantreṇa devāya puṣpaṃ dadyātmantreṇa devāya dhūpaṃ dadyātsuprakāśa ityādimantreṇa devāya dīpaṃ dadyātnaivedyamityādinā devāya naivedyaṃ dadyātdadyādvā pṛthagādhāraṃ tattannāma samuccaransācchādanaṃ gṛhaṃ prokṣya paṭhedenaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥdevatāsthitidāneṣu sumerusadṛśo bhavayat tvayā vidhṛto devastasmāt tvaṃ suravanditaḥmāyavidhṛtadehasya tasya mūrtervidhāraṇātsarvakāmaprado bhūtvā śāntiṃ me kuru te namaḥātmanaḥ kāmamuddiśya dadyāddevāya sādhakaḥenaṃ kaṃ paṭedityākāṅkṣāyāmāha geha tvamityādikukṣau udare || 242dadyātaṅgīkuru maheśāna kṛpayā sannidhīyatām

sanskrit: śaṅkhatūryādighoṣaistaṃ sthāpayedvedikopariiti devaṃ sthirīkṛtya bhavanaṃ prārthayet punaḥutsṛṣṭe tvayi me lokāḥ sthirāḥ santu nirāmayāḥmāṃ ca me parivārāṃśca devadhāmni nivāsayayatphalaṃ tatphalaṃ me'dya jāyatāṃ tvatprasādataḥviśvāsaḥ tasmaivedikopari sthāpayetpunarbhavanaṃ gṛhaṃ prārthayetyāvaddivāniśānāthau tāvanme vartatāṃ kulamdarpaṇādyanyavastūni dhvajaṃ cāpi nivedayetśivāya vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥpṛṣṭhe vahasi deveśaṃ pūjyo'si tridaśairapinigamāgamatantrāṇi daśanāgre vasanti tevāsaṃ dadātu kailāse tvaṃ māṃ pālaya sarvadāyathā stūyānmaheśāni tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇudevānāṃ jayado bhīmo danujānāṃ vināśakṛtvṛṣabha tvamityādidaśanāgre dantāgresuprītaḥ bhavatu iti śeṣaḥ || 256devyai samarpito bhaktyā jahi śatrūnnamo'stu tenamaste'stu khagendrāya pakṣirāja namo'stu tetathā māmaridarpaghna viṣṇoragre nivāsayatvayi prīte jagannāthaḥ prītaḥ siddhiṃ prayacchatinṛtyairgītaiśca vāditraiḥ sāmātyaḥ sahabāndhavaḥveśmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ natvā'śayeddvijān

sanskrit: ārāmasetusaṃkrāmaśākhināmīrito'pi saḥpūjāhomau tathā sarvaṃ gṛhadānavidhānavattasmai devāyaarcyā'pratiṣṭhite deve pūjādānaṃ vidhīyateyena pratiṣṭhitā devī tūrṇaṃ yacchati vāñchitamsaṃkalpaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā yajedvāstvīśvaraṃ tataḥvidhāya sādhakairvipraiḥ pratimāsannidhiṃ vrajetānīyā'rcāmarcayitvā snāpayet sādhakottamaḥveśyādvāramṛdā cāpi pradyumnahṛdajātayākārayitvā gandhatailaiḥ snāpayet pratimāṃ sudhīḥityādibhiḥ | taddine śrīmadādyāpratiṣṭhādineherambo gaṇeśaḥsnāpayetbhasmanetyādi || 272ete nigaditāḥ snāne kaṣāyāḥ pañca bhūruhāḥpāṭalīkusumañcāpi pañcapuṣpaṃ prakīrtitamvarvarātulasībilvaṃ patratrayamudāhṛtampañcāmṛte gandhataile toyayogaṃ vivarjayetetaddravyasya toyena snāpayāmi namo vadetkavoṣṇasalilaiścāpi snāpayet pratimāṃ budhaḥśālītaṇḍulacūrṇena mārjayitvā virukṣayetityapekṣāyāmāha eteṣvityādināsammārjitāṅgīṃ pratimāṃ pūjāsthānaṃ samānayetkalaśaiḥ snāpayedarcāṃ bhaktyā sādhakasattamaḥpādyārghyādyairarcayitvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥ

sanskrit: śaivatīrthe kṛtaśrādhāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatimyatrāsti tatra tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāni caturdaśaanādibhūtabhūteśamahimā vāgagocaraḥvidyate vidyate naitalliṅgarūpadhare hareśivakṣetre mahatīrthe tathā jānīhi kālikeprabhāvaḥ śivaliṅgasya mayā vaktuṃ na śakyatesādhakaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā svābhīṣṭaphalasiddhayeso'śvamedhāyutaphalaṃ labhate sādhakottamaḥghṛtaṃ svastikasindūraṃ śaṅkhakajjalarocanāḥadhivāsavidhau viṃśaddravyāṇyetāni yojayetanenā'muṣyapadataḥ śubhamastvadhivāsanampratiṣṭhāpūrvasāyāhne ityādibhiḥdhavalasarṣapaḥ || 26tataḥ praśastipātreṇa tridhaivamadhivāsayetgṛhadānavidhānena dugdhādyaiḥ snāpayettataḥpūjānuṣṭhānavidhinā gaṇeśādīn samarcayetdhyāyet sadāśivaṃ śāntaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabhamvibhūtiliptasarvāṅgaṃ nāgālaṅkārabhūṣitamyuktaṃ trinayanaṃ bibhrajjaṭājūṭadharaṃ vibhumkapālaṃ pāvakaṃ pāśaṃ pinākaṃ paraśuṃ karaiḥvarañca bibhrataṃ sarvairdevairmunivaraiḥ stutamvibhrataṃ dadhatamhimakundendusaṅkāśaṃ vṛṣāsanavirājitamgīyamānamumākāntamekāntaśaraṇapriyamsaṃpūjyā'vāhya talliṅge yajecchaktyā vidhānataḥ

sanskrit: mūlamatra manuṃ vakṣye maheśasya mahātmanaḥardhendubindubhūṣāḍhyaṃ śivabījaṃ prakīrtitamniveśya divyaśayyāyāṃ devīmevaṃ viśodhayetmāyayā'tra karanyāsau prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaretmāyayā hrī/ bījenapīnottuṅgapayodharāṃ bhayaharāṃ pītāmbarāṃ cintayetatastu daśa dikpālān vṛṣabhañca samarcayetbhagavatyā manuṃ vakṣye yenā'rādhyā jaganmayībinduyuktaṃ tadante ca yojayedvahnivallabhāmdadhiyuktamāṣabhaktaṃ śarkarādisamanvitamsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ mantreṇānena cārpayetpiśācā mātaro yakṣā bhūtāśca pitarastathāparivārya mahādevaṃ tiṣṭhantu girijāmapigītavādyādibhiḥ sadbhirvidadhyānmaṅgalakriyāmsaṃkalpaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā pañca devān prapūjayetsvāheti mantro jātaḥ | thāntamityatra sāntamiti vākvacitmāṣabhaktaṃ sarvadevabaliṃ hareddadyātityādikam || 50enaṃ hrī/ śrī/ dū/ svāhetīmammaheśadvārapālāṃśca yajet bhaktyā samāhitaḥdvārapālāḥ śivasyaite sarve śastrāstrapāṇayaḥmaṇḍale sarvatobhadre sthāpayedvā śubhāsanesnāpayitvā'rcayet bhaktyā ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥkṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sādhuḥ prārthayet śaṅkaraṃ śivampinākapāṇe sarveśa mahādeva namo'stu te

sanskrit: bhagavatyā sahā'gaccha kṛpāṃ kuru namo namaḥprasīda śambhunā sārdhaṃ namaste'stu harapriyepañca devān brahmādīn || 53sampūjyānmaheśadvārapālānāha nandītyādinaikenayajāmahe ityādinā mantreṇadevīmitivā kvacitprītā bhava maheśāni sarvasampatkarī bhavasukhaṃ nivasatāṃ gehe prīyetāṃ bhaktavatsalaupradakṣiṇaṃ tridhā veśma kārayitvā praveśayetadhastribhāgaliṅgasya ropayenmūlamuccarantāvadatra mahādeva sthiro bhava namo'stu teuttarāgrāṃ tatra vedīṃ mūlenaiva praveśayetyāvaddivāniśānāthau tāvadatra sthirā bhavasadāśive vedīṃ praveśayet || 67p. 456) anena sudṛḍhīkṛtya liṅgaṃ spṛṣṭvā paṭhedimamyakṣā nāgāśca vetālāḥ lokapālā maharṣayaḥyasya siṃhāsane yuktā bhūcarāḥ khecarāstathāāgaccha bhagavannatra brahmanirmitayantraketato devapratiṣṭhoktavidhinā snāpayan śivampunardhyātvā maheśānaṃ puṣpaṃ liṅgopari nyasetcandanāgurukāśmīrairvilipya girijāpatimjātanāmādisaṃskārān kṛtvā pūrvavidhānavatsudṛḍhīkṛtya vedīmiti śeṣaḥabhyarcya tatra devasya mūrtīraṣṭau prapūjayetrudro'gnirugro vāyuḥ syād bhīma ākāśaśabditaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānaḥ sūrya ityete mūrtayo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥpūrvādīśānaparyantamaṣṭa mūrtīḥ kramādyajetvṛṣaṃ vitānaṃ gehādi dadyādīśāya sādhakaḥtataḥ kṛtāñjalirbhaktyā prārthayet pārvatīpatimprāguktavidhānena tatra liṅge prāṇānniveśayet || 75tatra vedyāmevakṣitirityādibhyāṃ dvābhyām || 78evamevā'gneyādiṣu kramato'nyā api sapta mūrtīryajetiṣṭvā pūjayitvā || 81prasīda bhagavan śambho sarvakāraṇakāraṇatāvadasmin gṛhe tiṣṭha namaste parameśvarana tatpāpaiḥ pralipye'haṃ prasādāttava dhūrjaṭeprabhāte punarāgatya snāpayeccandraśekharamtataḥ sugandhitoyānāṃ kalaśaiḥ śatasaṃkhyakaiḥsaṃpūjya taṃ yathāśaktyā prārthayet bhaktibhāvataḥsampūrṇamastu tat sarvaṃ tvatprasādādumāpatetāvanme kīrtiratulā loke tiṣṭhatu sarvadāviṣṇubrahmendrasūryādyairarcitāya namo namaḥśuddhairityāditam śivambhakṣyaiḥ peyaiśca vāsobhirdaridrān paritoṣayetsthāvaraṃ śivaliṅgaṃ tu na kadāpi vicālayetsaṅkṣepāt parameśāni sarvāgamasamuddhṛtāvidheyaṃ tatra kiṃ bhaktaistanme kathaya tattvataḥtyājyā vā kena doṣeṇa tadupāyaśca bhaṇyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dinadvaye taddviguṇaṃ taddvaiguṇyaṃ dinatrayetadā'ṣṭakalaśairdevaṃ snāpayitvā yajet sudhīḥpunaḥ susaṃskṛtaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet sādhakāgraṇīḥśrīdevyuvāca yadītyādi | tatra pūjābādhe sati || 95patitaṃ duṣṭabhūmyādau na devaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥsparśādidoṣaduṣṭaṃ tu saṃskṛtya punararcayetsarvadā pūjayettatra svaṃ svamiṣṭaṃ sukhāptayeniḥśreyasāya tat sarvaṃ saviśeṣaṃ prakīrtitamanicchanto'pi vivaśāḥ kṛṣyante karmavāyunājāyante ca pralīyante vartante karmaṇo vaśātpravṛttaye'lpabodhānāṃ duśceṣṭitanivṛttayeaśubhāt karmaṇo yānti prāṇinastīvrayātanāmprayāntyāyāntyamutreha karmaśṛṅkhalayantritāḥtāvanna jāyate mokṣo nṛṇāṃ kalpaśatairapitathā baddho bhavejjīvaḥ karmabhiścā'śubhaiḥ śubhaiḥtāvanna labhate mokṣaṃ yāvat jñānaṃ na vindatijāyate kṣīṇatamasāṃ viduṣāṃ nirmalātmanāmsatyamekaṃ paraṃ brahma viditvaivaṃ sukhī bhavetpariniścitatattvo yaḥ sa muktaḥ karmabandhanātvimalāntaḥkaraṇānām || 112brahmaivā'hamiti jñātvā mukto bhavati dehabhṛtdehastho'pi na dehastho jñātvaivaṃ muktibhāg bhavetvihāya brahmaniṣṭho yaḥ sa mukto nā'tra saṃśayaḥsvapnalabdhena rājyena rājāno mānavāstadākliśyantastapasā jñānaṃ vinā mokṣaṃ na yānti te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmajñānavihīnāścenniṣkṛtiṃ te vrajanti kimsanti cet pannagā muktāḥ paśupakṣijalecarāḥpariniścitatattvaḥ || 114tapasā kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādināniṣkṛtim nistāram | vrajanti prāpnuvanti || 120stutirjapo'dhamo bhāvo bahiḥ pūjā'dhamādhamāsarvaṃ brahmeti viduṣo na yogo na ca pūjanamkiṃ tasya japayajñādyaistapobhirniyamavrataiḥsvabhāvāt brahmabhūtasya kiṃ pūjā dhyānadhāraṇānāpi dhyeyo na vā dhyātā sarvaṃ brahmeti jānataḥkiṃ tasya bandhanaṃ kasmānmuktimicchanti durdhiyaḥdhyānarūpaṃ bhajanamtadbhinnaṃ pūjanamapi nāsti tasya || 123dhāraṇā cittavṛttinirodhaḥna punarbhavaḥ na punarutpattiḥnirliptaḥ anāsaktaḥsvayaṃ virājate tatra hyapraviṣṭaḥ praviṣṭavattathaiva bhāti sadrūpo hyātmā sākṣī svarūpataḥsadaikarūpaścinmātro vikāraparivarjitaḥpaśyanto'pi na paśyanti māyāprāvṛtabuddhayaḥtathaiva māyayā dehe bahudhā'tmānamīkṣatetathaiva buddheścāñcalyaṃ paśyantyātmanyakovidāḥnaṣṭe dehe tathaivātmā samarūpo virājateanūhanīyam || 128ityādyardhena
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarhi kasya janmādikaṃ bhavati tatrāha janmetyādisadaikarūpa iti tatrāha yathetyādijānannihaiva muktaḥ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥātmanā'tmānamājñāya mukto bhavati mānavaḥloke'sminnātmasambandhāt bhavantyanye priyāḥ śivevicāryamāṇe tritaye ātmaivaiko'vaśiṣyatevijñātā svayamevātmā yo jānāti sa ātmavitcaturvidhāvadhūtānāmetadeva paraṃ dhanamkimidaṃ śrūyate citramavadhūtāścaturvidhāḥcaturvidhāvadhūtānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ saviśeṣataḥśrīdevyuvāca dvividhāvityādi || 141gṛhāśrame vasanto'pi jñeyāste yatayaḥ priyeśaivāvadhūtāste jñeyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ kulārcitevidadhyuḥ sarvakarmāṇi madudīritavartmanāniṣiddhamannaṃ toyañca na gṛhṇīyuḥ kadācanaprāgeva kathito dharma ācāraśca varānanesarvamāgamamārgeṇa śaivabrāhmāvadhūtayoḥpūrṇaḥ paramahaṃsākhyaḥ parivrāḍaparaḥ priyetadā lokālaye tiṣṭhannātmānaṃ sa tu śodhayetbrahmamantropāsakā ya ityādi || 143sadā brahmaparo bhūtvā sādhayet jñānamuttamamkuryādātmocitaṃ karma sadā vairāgyamāśritaḥyatetā'tmānamuddhartuṃ tattvajñānavivekataḥgṛhastho vā'pyudāsīnastasyā'bhīṣṭāya tad bhaveto/ tatsanmantraniṣpannāḥ sampūrṇāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmārpaṇamastu vākyaṃ pānabhojanakarmaṇoḥtadeva kāryaṃ brahmajñairidaṃ dharmaṃ sanātanameva vidhiḥ | asya brahmaniṣṭhasya || 97mātāpitroḥ || 99yāṃ kṛtvā brahmasampattiṃ labhante bhuvi mānavāḥpūrvavat paramabrahma dhyātvā sādhakasattamaḥjapaṃ samarpya vidhivat pūrvavat praṇamet sudhīḥyadanuṣṭhānato mantrī śuddhāntaḥkaraṇo bhavetparameśvaraṃ ṅe'ntamuktvā vidmahe tadanantaramiyaṃ śrībrahmagāyatrī caturvargapradāyinīyadyatkarma prakurvīta brahmamantreṇa sādhayetpūrvavat praṇamed brahma prātaḥkṛtyamidaṃ smṛtamtaddaśāṃśena havanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥbrāhmaṇān bhojayenmantrī puraścaraṇakarmaṇina kālaśuddhiniyamo na vā sthānanirūpaṇambrahmetyādimantram || 111sādhayet paramaṃ mantraṃ svecchācāreṇa sādhakaḥvinā nyāsaṃ vinā mudrāṃ vinā setuṃ varānaneakasmāt paramabrahmasākṣātkāro bhaved dhruvamsādhane brahmamantrasya bhāvaśuddhirvidhīyatemahāmanoḥ sādhane tu vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgāyate dhruvamnistārabījametāvat brahmamantrasya sādhanamkalau durbalajīvānāmasādhyāni maheśvaripratyavāyo na bhavet | vyaṅgam aṅgahīnamapi || 120yadyapi tathāpītyadhyāhāryam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brāhmyeṇānena mantreṇa sarvakarmāṇi sādhayetnāstyetasmānmahāmantrādupāyāntaramambikegehastasya mahātīrthaṃ dehaḥ puṇyamayo bhaveto/ tatsaditi deveśi tavāgre satyamīritamprādurbhūto'yamoṃ tatsat sarvamantrottamottamaḥmantrānyaiḥ śodhanenā'laṃ syāccedetena śodhitamsvecchācāraḥ śuddhacittaḥ sa eva bhuvi kaularāṭsākṣād brahmasamo dehī sārthamenaṃ japan manumsādhanādasya mantrasya bhavenmṛtyuñjayaḥ svayamjaptvaitasya maheśāni sādhakaḥ siddhibhāg bhavetnāpi daive na vā pitre nārṣe kṛtye'dhikāritātrayo'nye yogabhogāḍhyā muktāḥ sarve śivopamāḥprārabdhamaśnan viharenniṣedhavidhivarjitaḥaśnan bhuñjānaḥturīyo vicaret kṣauṇīṃ niḥsaṅkalpo nirudyamaḥnirnaketastitikṣuḥ syānniḥśaṅko nirupadravaḥmukto virakto nirdvandvo haṃsācāraparo yatiḥlakṣaṇaṃ saviśeṣeṇa sādhūnāṃ matsvarūpiṇāmsarvatīrthaphalāvāptirjāyate manujanmanāmkulasannyāsināṃ dehe santi tāni sadā priyeyairarcitāḥ kuladravyairmānavaiḥ kulasādhavaḥabhakṣyamapi bhakṣyaṃ syāt yeṣāṃ saṃsparśamātrataḥātmaśarīranirvāhārthavyāpāraśūnyaḥathāvadhūtānāṃ māhātmyamāha eteṣāmityādibhiḥkuladravyaiḥ madyādibhiḥ || 175

sanskrit: śuddhyanti yeṣāṃ saṃsparśāttān vinā ko'nyamarcayetye'rcayanti sakṛdbhaktyā te'pi pūjyā mahītaleantyajo'pi yamāśritya pūtaḥ kaulapadaṃ vrajetkuladharme nimajjanti sarve dharmāstathā priyeye punantyātmasambandhān mlecchaśvapacapāmarānkulācāre viśanto'pi sarve gacchanti kaulatāmtathā kulāmbudhau magnā na bhaveyurjanāḥ pṛthakte sarve'smin kulācāre bhaveyuradhikāriṇaḥnaṭaśca karaṇaścaiva khaso drāviḍa eva ca || itisarvadharmaparibhraṣṭāste gacchantyadhamāṃ gatimtān vañcayan kulīno'pi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetkaulaṃ na kuryāt yaḥ kaulaḥ so'dhamo yātyadhogatimtasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyamekasmin kaulike kṛtekaulā bhavantaste pāśairmuktā yānti paraṃ padamsnehena śraddhayā premṇā pūjyā mānyāḥ parasparambhavābdhitaraṇe setuḥ kuladharmo hi nāparaḥdahyante karmajālāni kuladharmaniṣevaṇātpāvayanti kulācāraiste jñeyāḥ kaulikottamāḥmahānirvāṇatantrasya pūrvārdhaṃ lokapāvanamsarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ so'nte nirvāṇamāpnuyāttantrarājamidaṃ jñātvā jāyate sarvaśāstravitjānannetanmahātantraṃ karmapāśairvimucyatesa jñānī brahmavit sādhurya etadvetti kālikekimanyairbahubhistantrairjñātvedaṃ sarvavidbhavettava praśnena tantre'smiṃstat sarvaṃ suprakāśitam

sanskrit: mahānirvāṇatantraṃ me tathā jānīhi suvratebhāsvāṃstejaḥsu tantreṣu tantrarājamidaṃ tathāpaṭhitvā pāṭhayitvā'pi brahmajñānī bhavennaraḥna tasya vaṃśe deveśi paśurbhavati karhicitśṛṇvannetanmahātantraṃ karmabandhādvimucyatevandanaṃ parameśāni nṛṇāṃ kaivalyadāyakamsarvadharmānvitaṃ tantraṃ nātaḥparataraṃ kvacitparārdhamasya yo vetti sa sarvajño na saṃśayaḥtrikālavārtāṃ trailokyavṛttāntaṃ kathituṃ kṣamaḥmahānirvāṇatantrasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīmviditvaitanmahātantraṃ brahmanirvāṇamāpnuyāt

sanskrit: lubdhā dhanārjane vyagrāḥ sadā cañcalamānasāḥteṣāṃ hitāya mokṣāya brahmamārgo'yamīritaḥbrahmadīkṣāṃ vinā devi kaivalyāya sukhāya caparabrahmopāsane tu sādhakecchāvidhiḥ śivesvecchācāreṇeṣṭasiddhistadvinā ko'nyamāśrayetdhṛtvā taccaraṇāmbhojaṃ prārthayed bhaktibhāvataḥśeṣaḥ | annādhīnāsavaḥ annavaśībhūtaprāṇāḥkalāvityādiprātariti | sādhakecchaiva vidhiḥ | yatra parabrahmopāsanetvatpadāmbhoruhacchāyāṃ dehi mūrdhni yaśodhanakṛtāñcalipuṭo bhūtvā tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhet guroḥ puraḥāhūya kṛpayā dadyāt sacchiṣyāya mahāmanumsvavāme śiṣyamānīya kāruṇyenā'valokayetjapedaṣṭaśataṃ mantraṃ sādhakasyeṣṭasiddhayesaptadhā śrāvayet mantraṃ sadguruḥ karuṇānidhiḥnātra pūjādyapekṣā'sti saṃkalpaṃ mānasañcaretvinītaścetyādikamkṛpāyuktayā dṛṣṭyādakṣetyādi | vāmataḥ vāme karṇe | mantram pūrvoktamevaupadeśeti | atra brahmamantropadeśavidhau | caret kuryātutthāpayed guruḥ snehādimaṃ mantramudīrayanjitendriyaḥ satyavādī valārogyaṃ sadā'stu tegurorājñāvaśībhūtvā vihareddevavad bhuvibrahmabhūtasya deveśi kimanyairbahusādhanaiḥgurukāruṇyamātreṇa brahmadīkṣāṃ samāśrayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viprā vipretarāścaiva sarve'pyatrādhikāriṇaḥtaṃ mantramevāha uttiṣṭha vatsetyādi || 136tata iti | svaṃ dhanam ātmānaṃ vābrahmasvarūpaḥgurvityādiityādinā | atra brahmamantresvecchācārī nirvikalpo mantrasyā'sya prasādataḥbrahmā brahmarṣayaścāpi devā devarṣayastathāupāsitā brahmabhūtāḥ paramātmaprasādataḥsvīyamantraṃ gururdadyāt śiṣyebhyo hyavicārayanmātulo bhāgineyāṃśca naptṝn mātāmaho'pi caahamityādinā | ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayo'bhavamiti śeṣaḥnāradādayaḥrājarṣayo janakādayaḥsiddhe brahmamahāmantre taddoṣo naiva vidyatebrahmabhūto naraḥ pūtaḥ puṇyapāpairna lipyatesvasvavarṇottamārate tu pūjyā mānyā viśeṣataḥtasmāt sarve pūjayeyurbrahmajñān brahmadīkṣitānpatanti ghoranarake yāvadbhāskaratārakamtasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ pāpaṃ brahmopāsakanindanātityādi | yo doṣaḥ ukta iti śeṣaḥ || 147dvitīyātatpuruṣaḥbhaveyuḥ | itare kṣatriyādayaḥgacchanti brahmasāyujyaṃ tathaiva tava sādhanāttṛtīyollāsaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmasāyujyam brahmatvamparamānandasampannā śaṅkaraṃ paripṛcchatisarvalokapriyakaraṃ sākṣādbrahmapadapradamtṛptā'smi jagadīśāna tava vākyāmṛtaplutāgacchanti brahmasāyujyaṃ tathaiva mama sādhanātkathitaṃ yadityādi || 1vāgamṛtaplutā tāvakīnavāgrūpapīyūṣe nimagnābrahmasāyujyajananaṃ yattvayā kathitaṃ prabhomantraḥ ko vā'tra vihito dhyānapūjādikañca kimko hyanyastvāmṛte śambho bhavavyādhibhiṣagguruḥuvāca parayā prītyā pārvatīṃ pārvatīpatiḥtava sādhanato yena brahmasāyujyamaśnutedvitīyaślokagataiḥ padairanvayaḥtvayā kathitaṃ tacca kīdṛśaṃ vartate etadapi veditumicchāmitasya madīyasādhanasya | atra mama sādhanejanmarūpasya vyādheścikitsakarājaḥitītyādi | uvāca uttaramiti śeṣaḥśṛṇvityanvayaḥtvatto jātaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tvaṃ jagajjananī śivetvayaivotpāditaṃ bhadre tvadadhīnamidaṃ jagattvaṃ jānāsi jagat sarvaṃ na tvāṃ jānāti kaścanadhūmāvatī tvaṃ bagalā bhairavī chinnamastakāsarvaśaktisvarūpā tvaṃ sarvadevamayī tanuḥsākṣātparā'tyutkṛṣṭā prakṛtirasītyevamanvayaḥ kāryaḥmahattattvamādiryasya tanmahadādi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanuḥ taveti śeṣaḥnirākārā'pi sākārā kastvāṃ veditumarhatidānavānāṃ vināśāya dhatse nānāvidhāstanūḥtvameva viśvarakṣārthaṃ nānāśastrāstradhāriṇīkathitaṃ sarvatantreṣu bhāvāśca kathitāstrayaḥvīrasādhanakarmāṇi pratyakṣāṇi kalau yugetasmāt sarvaprayatnena sādhayet kulasādhanambrahmajñānayuto martyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥbhavati na ko'pītyarthaḥnānāvidhāstanūreva darśayannāha caturbhujetyādi || 17brahmajñāne samutpanne medhyāmedhyaṃ na vidyatekimastyamedhyaṃ tasyāgre sarvaṃ brahmeti jānataḥtuṣṭāyāṃ tvayi deveśi sarveṣāṃ toṣaṇaṃ bhavettvatto jātaṃ jagat sarvaṃ parabrahmasisṛkṣayānimittamātraṃ tadbrahma sarvakāraṇakāraṇamsadaikarūpaṃ cinmātraṃ nirliptaṃ sarvavastuṣusatyaṃ jñānamanādyantamavāṅmanasagocaramākṛtiśūnyatvāt vāṅmanasayorapyaviṣayabhūtamkāraṇaṃ nimittabhūtamkaroṣi pāsi haṃsyante jagadetaccarācarammahāsaṃhārasamaye kālaḥ sarvaṃ grasiṣyatimahākālasya kalanāt tvamādyā kālikā parākālatvādādibhūtatvādādyā kālīti gīyatevācātītaṃ manogamyaṃ tvamekaivā'vaśiṣyasetvaṃ sarvādiranādistvaṃ kartrī hartrī ca pālikā

sanskrit: kāraṇam anto nāśaśca yasya tathābhūtampralayakāle || 29kāraṇasvarūpāatikrāntavāk | mano'gamyam manaso'pyaprāpyamyatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tatphalaṃ tava sādhanātvibhedāt kathitaṃ devi kutracidguptasādhanambhaviṣyanti tariṣyanti mānuṣā gatakilviṣāḥkulācāreṇa pūtātmā sākṣācchivamayo bhavetyoge'pi bhogavirahaḥ kaulastūbhayamaśnuteityādinānānābhāvena ca | vibhedāt viśeṣāt | kutracit tantrādiṣuya iti | yatra guptasādhane vyaktasādhane vāsākṣācchivamayaḥ sākṣācchivasvarūpaḥubhayamaśnute yogaṃ bhogañca labhatesarve devāśca devyaśca pūjitā nātra saṃśayaḥtasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate kaulikārcanātkulācāravihīnastu brāhmaṇaḥ śvapacādhamaḥyasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa brahmajñānī naro bhavetsarvadharmottamāt kaulāt paro dharmo na vidyatevyaktībhaviṣyatyacirāt saṃvṛtte prabale kalauna sthāsyati vinā kaulān paśavo mānavā bhuvina sthāsyati varārohe tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥeka ityādi | pūjitāḥ teneti śeṣaḥ || 40śvapaca ityādi | atiricyate uttamatāvattvādviśiṣyateyasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇetyādi || 43
source_edition: Muktabodha M00049 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pravṛtte || 45na sthāsyati śive śānte tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥbhaviṣyati kuleśāni tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥbhaviṣyanti mahāprājñe tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥgarhiṣyanti ca bhartāraṃ tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥdruhyanti gurumitrādīn tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥasamyakphalino vṛkṣāstadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥmithaḥ samprahariṣyanti tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥgūḍhapānaṃ cariṣyanti tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥśānte he saṃyatacitte || 48 || surataraṅgiṇī gaṅgā|| 53 || dhanakaṇehayā vittaleśākāṅkṣayātadaiva pravalaḥ kalirjñātavyaḥkalāvapi tathā kuryāt kulavartmānusārataḥvyaktācārā dayāśīlā na hi tān bādhate kaliḥanuraktāḥ svadāreṣu na hi tān bādhate kaliḥkulasādhanasatyā ye na hi tān bādhate kaliḥye dadyuḥ satyavacase na hi tān bādhate kaliḥkuladharmeṣu niṣṭhā ye na hi tān bādhate kaliḥkurvanti kaulasevāṃ ye na hi tān vādhate kaliḥsevante tvāṃ kulācārairna hi tān bādhate kaliḥśeṣaḥ || 56 || nahi tān bādhate tānna pīḍayatigurvityādi | yuktāḥ saṅgatāḥ | anuraktāḥ anurāgavantaḥmadyamāṃsādīniye kurvanti kulācārairna hi tān bādhate kaliḥye kurvanti kulācārairna hi tān bādhate kaliḥ

sanskrit: namaskurvanti ye bhaktyā na hi tān bādhate kaliḥparopakāravratināṃ sādhūnāṃ kiṅkaraḥ kaliḥsatyapratijñakaulānāṃ śreyaḥ saṅkalpamātrataḥnṛṇāmāsīt kalau puṇyaṃ kevalaṃ na tu duṣkṛtamparadrohaparā ye ca te narāḥ kalikiṅkarāḥdveṣṭāraḥ kulaniṣṭhānāṃ te jñeyāḥ kalikiṅkarāḥsaṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ bhadre prītaye tava pārvatikulatattvam strīkusumādi | kuladravyam madyamāṃsādivratamastyeṣāmiti paropakāravratinaḥ teṣāmsthāsyatyekaṃ satyamātraṃ tasmāt satyamayo bhavettadeva saphalaṃ karma satyaṃ jānīhi suvratetasmāt sarvātmanā martyaḥ satyamekaṃ samāśrayetsayathīnaṃ tapo vyarthamūṣare vapanaṃ yathāsatyamūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ satyāt parataro na hikulācāro'pi satyena kartavyo vyaktabhāvataḥtasmāt prakāśataḥ kuryāt kaulikaḥ kulasādhanampraśaṃsiṣyannāha prakaṭe'tretyādi || 73hīyate hīnaṃ bhavati tyaktaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥyaduktaṃ kulatantreṣu na śastaṃ pravale kalaudvipādo dvāpare devi pādamātraṃ kalau yugetasmāt satyaṃ samāśritya sarvakarmāṇi sādhayettatrānṛtapraveśaścet kuto niḥśreyasaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ karma naraḥ kuryāt svasvavarṇāśramoditamvratodbāhau puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanantathākuladharmasyetyādi

sanskrit: pādamātram dharmasyāvaśiṣyate iti śeṣaḥluṣyate iti lopaḥ | tasmin karmaṇi ghañmṛtakriyāṃ pitṛśrāddhaṃ kuryādāgamasammatamyātrāṃ gṛhapraveśañca navavastrādidhāraṇamgṛhārambhapratiṣṭhāñca devānāṃ sthāpanantathāṛtumāsavarṣakṛtyaṃ nityaṃ naimittikañca yatmayoktena vidhānena tat sarvaṃ sādhayennaraḥvinaṣṭaḥ sarvakarmabhyo viṣṭhāyāṃ sa bhavet kṛmiḥyadā yat kriyate karma viparītāya tadbhavetaśraddhayā viśvāsābhāvena || 91devatā kupitā tasya vighnastasya pade padeyo'nyamārgaiḥ kriyāṃ kuryāt sa mahāpātakī bhavetsa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvaccandradivākaraukevalaṃ sūtravāho'sau caṇḍālādadhamo'pi saḥveśyāgamanajaṃ pāpaṃ tasya puṃso dine dinepitaro'pi na cāśnanti yatastanmalapūyavatdaive paitre kulācāre nādhikāro'sya jāyatebhavet saṃskārahīno bhavedityarthaḥihāmutra phalaṃ nāsti kāyakleśo dhanakṣayaḥśrāddhaṃ tadviphalaṃ so'pi pitṛbhirnarakaṃ vrajettasmānmartyaḥ prayatnena śāṅkaraṃ matamāśrayetaśāmbhavaṃ kṛtaṃ karma sarvaṃ devi nirarthakamśāmbhavācārahīnasya narakānnaiva niṣkṛtiḥsādhanaṃ yanmaheśāni tadeva tava sādhanamniṣkṛtirnistāraḥ || 104

sanskrit: bheṣajaṃ kalirogāṇāṃ śrūyatāṅgadato mamacaturthollāsaḥtava śaktyā vayaṃ śaktāḥ sṛṣṭisthitilayādiṣunānāprayāsasādhyāni varṇituṃ kena śakyateteṣāmarcāsādhanāni kathitāni yathāmatiasya prasādāt kalyāṇi mayi te karuṇedṛśīpravṛttaḥ śrīsadāśiva uvāca tvamādyā parametyādiākārāśca yeṣāṃ rūpāṇāṃ tānikāruṇyaleśena dayāyā lavena | teṣāṃ tava rūpāṇāmetattu ataḥparamucyamānantu | asya guptasādhanasyakathayāmi tava prītyai mama prāṇādhika priyetvatprāptimūlamacirāttava santoṣakāraṇambahuprayāsāsaktānāmetadeva paraṃ dhanamsukhasādhyamabāhulyaṃ bhaktānāṃ phaladaṃ mahatyasya śravaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto'pi jāyatebījametat samuddhṛtya dvitīyamuddharet priyetṛtīyaṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi dīpasaṃsthaḥ prajāpatiḥtat guptasādhanam || 5etadeva ataḥparamucyamānaṃ guptasādhanamevatatra sādhanesamuddhṛtya dvitīyaṃ bījamuddharetbījatrayānte parameśvari sambodhanaṃ padamsarvavidyāmayī devī vidyeyaṃ parameśvarīprajapet sādhakādhīśaḥ dharmakāmārthasiddhayekāmavāgbhavatārādyā saptārṇā'ṣṭākṣarī tridhā

sanskrit: evantu pañcamantrā āsanpunarādyatrayaṃ bījaṃ vahnijāyāṃ tato vadetvadhvādyā praṇavādyā cedeṣā saptadaśī dvidhāsaṃkṣepādatra kathitā mantrāṇāṃ dvādaśa priyete sarve tava mantrāḥ syustvamādyā prakṛtiryataḥtridhā jātā | etaistribhiḥ sahitā nava mantrā vabhūvuḥpārvatīsambandhitve hetumāha tvamādyā prakṛtiryata iti || 19kathayāmi tava prītyai tathā lokahitāya catasmāt kulācārarataḥ sādhayecchaktisādhanamśaktipūjāvidhāvādye pañcatattvaṃ prakīrtitamneṣṭasiddhirbhavettasya vighnastasya pade padepañcatattvavihīnāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ na phalodbhavaḥtasmādādau pravakṣyāmi prātaḥkṛtyaṃ yathocitamdhyāyecchirasi śulkābje dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ gurumtadeva sādhanamāha kulācāramityādibhiḥvarābhayakaraṃ śāntaṃ karuṇāmayavigrahamsmerānanaṃ suprasannaṃ sādhakābhīṣṭadāyakampūjayitvā japenmantrī vāgbhavaṃ bījamuttamamtatastu praṇameddhīmān mantreṇā'nena sadgurumstriyā āliṅgitavigrahamāśliṣṭaśarīram || 27śeṣaḥnamaḥ sadgurave tubhyaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinekuladharmaprakāśāya tasmai śrīgurave namaḥpūrvavat pūjayitvā tāṃ mūlamantrajapañcaretmantreṇānena matimān praṇamediṣṭadevatām

sanskrit: ādyāyai kālikāyai te kartryai hartryai namonamaḥtyaktvā mūtrapurīṣañca dantadhāvanamācaretdṛṣṭiṃ pradarśayituṃ śīlaṃ yasya tasmai || 31mantramevāha | namaḥ sarveti || 35ādāvapa upaspṛśya praviśet salile tataḥsakṛt snātvā tathonmajya māntramācamanañcarettriraprāśyā'po dvirunmṛjya tvācamet kulasādhakaḥmūlamantraṃ dvādaśadhā tasyopari japet priyeabhiṣicya svamūrddhānaṃ saptacchidrāṇi rodhayetmāntramdvādaśavārañjapediti dvitīyenānvayaḥ || 39utthāya gātraṃ sammārjya pidadhyācchuddhavāsasīlalāṭe tilakaṃ kuryādgāyatryā baddhakuntalaḥsandhyāṃ samācarenmantrī tāntrikīṃ śṛṇu kathyateācamya pūrvavattoyaistīrthānyāvāhayecchivenarmade sindhu kāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuruhastadvayāṅgulibhī rodhayetācchādayet paridadhyādityarthaḥbindusaṃyutaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ tilakaṃ lalāṭe kuryātmayā kathyatepūrvavadācamya toye jale tīrthānyāvāhayetāsattimāvāhya tīrthaṃ salile mūlaṃ dvādaśadhā japetmadhyamānāmikāyogānmūloccāraṇapūrvakamvāmahaste samādāya chādayeddakṣapāṇinā

sanskrit: prajapya vedadhā toyaṃ dakṣahaste samānayetaṅkuśākhyā mahāmudrā trailokyākarṣaṇakṣametivinikṣipetjalaṃ samādāya gṛhītvā dakṣapāṇinā'cchādayetdakṣahaste samānayetdehāntaḥkaluṣaṃ tena recayet piṅgalākhyayātrivāraṃ tāḍayan mantrī hastau prakṣālayettataḥācamyoktena mantreṇa sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayetidamarghyaṃ tubhyamuktvā dadyāt svāhetyudīrayanprātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne trirūpāṃ guṇabhedataḥkṛṣṇājināmbaradharāṃ haṃsārūḍhāṃ śucismitāmśarīrāntaḥpāpaṃ recayenniṣkarṣayethastau prakṣālayeddhāvetnivedayeddadyātmantreṇārghyaṃ nivedayedityarthaḥ || 54śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇīṃ garuḍāsanāmyuvatīṃ satataṃ dhyāyenmadhye mārtaṇḍamaṇḍaleśuklāṃ śuklāmbaradharāṃ vṛṣāsanakṛtāśrayāmvibhratīṃ karapadmaiśca vṛddhāṃ galitayauvanāmprātaḥkāle dhyāyet | agre'pyevamevānvayaḥ kartavyaḥmadhyāhna iti | tāṃ gāyatrīmtathābhūtāmtathābhūtāmdhvastatāruṇyāmdatvā japettu gāyatrīṃ daśadhā śatadhā'pi vā

sanskrit: ādyāyai padamuccārya vidmahe tadanantarameṣā tu tava gāyatrī mahāpāpapraṇāśinītatastu tarpayedbhadre devarṣipitṛdevatāḥśaktau tu praṇave māyāṃ namaḥsthāne dviṭhaṃ vadetdaśavāraṃ śatavāraṃ vetyarthaḥprītitaḥdharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyojayedityartha itigāyatrījapādanantaraṃ tusarvasvarūpāṃ ṅeyuktāṃ sāyudhā'pi tathā paṭhetādyāyai kālikāyai ta idamarghyaṃ tato dviṭhaḥyathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā devyā vāmakare'rpayettarpayāmi svāhetyanenādyāṃ kālīṃ tarpayediti jñāpitamidamarghyaṃ svāheti mantra āsīt || 66natvā tīrthaṃ paṭhan stotraṃ devatādhyānatatparaḥtato dvārasya purataḥ sāmānyārghyaṃ prakalpayetādhāraśaktiṃ saṃpūjya tatrā'dhāraṃ niyojayetnikṣipya gandhaṃ puṣpañca tīrthānyāvāhayettataḥpūjayitvā taddaśadhā māyābījena mantrayetsāmānyārghyaṃ prakalpayet racayet || 69maṇḍale kamapyādhāraṃ niyojayet sthāpayettīrthānyāvāhayettatastajjalapuṣpaiśca pūjayed dvāradevatāḥgaṅgāñca yamunāñcaiva lakṣmīṃ vāṇīṃ tato yajetsmaran devyāḥ padāmbhojaṃ maṇḍapaṃ praviśet sudhīḥmāyābījena hrīmitibījena tajjalaṃ mantrayet

sanskrit: tathā ca tarjanīmadhyā dhenumudrā'mṛtapradetimantreṇa vāṇīṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet pūjayetmaṇḍapaṃ devīyajanamaṇḍapaṃ devīyajanamandiraṃ praviśetsāmānyārghyasya toyena prokṣayedyāgamandiramdivyānutsārayedvighnānastrādbhiścāntarīkṣagāncandanāgurukastūrīkarpūrairyāgamaṇḍapamvilikhya pūjayettatra kāmarūpāya hṛnmanuḥkamalāsanāya namo mantreṇaivāsanaṃ yajetyāgamandiraṃ prokṣayet prasiñcetbaddhavīrāsano mantrī vijayāṃ pariśodhayetamṛtavarṣiṇi tato'mṛtamākarṣaya dvidhāvaśamānaya ṭhadvandvaṃ saṃvidāśodhane manuḥāvāhanyādimudrāñca dhenuyonī pradarśayetvijayāṃ bhaṅgāmbhaṅgāyāḥ śodhane'yameva manuḥ proktaḥ || 83tridhaiva tarpayeddevīṃ hṛdi mūlaṃ samuccaransvāhāntenaiva manunā juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhekṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā devīdhyānaparāyaṇaḥantāṅgṛṣṭhakamuṣṭibhyāṃ tadeyaṃ sannirodhinītivijayāṃ juhuyāt dadyātvāme suvāsitaṃ toyaṃ kuladravyāṇi yāni cavahnibījena deveśi vahneḥ prākāramācaretastreṇa gharṣayitvā tat prakṣipet karaśuddhayeastreṇa choṭikābhiśca bhūtaśuddhimathā'caretkālikāṃ namet

sanskrit: gharṣayitvā prakṣipetatha digbandhanādanantaraṃ bhūtaśuddhimācaretmano niveśya mūle ca huṅkāreṇaiva kuṇḍalīmsvādhiṣṭhānaṃ samānīya tatvaṃ tatve niyojayetrasādijihvayā sārddhaṃ jalamagnau vilāpayetsparśāditvagyutaṃ vāyumākāśe pravilāpayetmahattatvañca prakṛtau tāṃ brahmaṇi vilāpayetniyojayet vilāpayet || 93jalādikamapyagnyādāvevameva vilāpayet || 95vilāpayetpuruṣaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇañca raktaśmaśruvilocanamsarvapāpasvarūpañca sarvadā'dhomukhasthitamtena pāpātmakaṃ dehaṃ śoṣayet sādhakāgraṇīḥcatuḥṣaṣṭyā kumbhakena dahet pāparatāntanūmtathābhūtam || 98pāpamātmani svasmin yasya evambhūtadehaṃ śoṣayettanūṃ dahetdvātriṃśatā recakena plāvayedamṭāmbhasāutpannaṃ bhāvayeddehaṃ navīnaṃ devatāmayamtena divyāvalokena dṛḍhīkuryānnijāṃ tanūmso'haṃ mantreṇa taddehe devyāḥ prāṇān nidhāpayetsamāhitamanāḥ kuryāt mātṛkānyāsamambikedagdhāṃ tanūṃ plāvayetdehaṃ bhāvayet cintayettanūṃ dṛḍhīkuryāt

sanskrit: tatra dehe devyāḥ prāṇānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kuryādityarthaḥdevatā mātṛkā devī bījaṃ vyañjanasaṃjñakamṛṣinyāsaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ karāṅganyāsamācaretuṃ ūṃ madhye ṭavargantu eṃ aiṃ madhye tavargakambindu sargāntarāle ca ṣaḍaṅge mantra īritaḥvinyasya nyāsavidhinā dhyāyenmātṛsarasvatīmkarāṅganyāsamācaret kuryāt || 107hakṣau bhrūmadhyage padme kaṇṭhe ca ṣoḍaśa svarānḍādiphāntān nābhideśe bādilāntāṃśca liṅgakeityantarmanasā nyasya mātṛkārṇān vahirnyasetyasyāstathābhūtāmoṣṭhadantottamāṅgāsya doḥpat sandhyagrageṣu cakakudyaṃśe ca hṛtpūrvaṃ pāṇipādayuge tataḥitthaṃ lipiṃ pravinyasya prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaretpūrayedātmano dehaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā tu kumbhayetdvātriṃśatā japan bījaṃ vāyuṃ dakṣeṇa recayetprāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāyetthamṛṣinyāsaṃ samācaretgāyatryādīni chandāṃsi ādyā kālī tu devatāśiro vadanahṛdguhyapādasarvāṅgakeṣu caayantu vyāpakanyāso yathoktaphalasiddhidaḥathavā mūlamantreṇa ṣaḍdīrgheṇa vinā priyenamaḥsvāhāvaṣaṭ hūñca vauṣaṭ phaṭ kramaśaḥ sudhīḥṛṣinyāsakramaḥ || 122mūlamantreṇaivā'ṅgakalpanā kartavyāśikhāyai vaṣaḍityuktaṃ kavacāya humīritam

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāyetthaṃ pīṭhanyāsaṃ samācaretsudhāmbudhiṃ maṇidvīpaṃ pārijātataruṃ tataḥtatra padmāsanaṃ vīro vinyaset hṛdayāmbujenyāsaṃ vidadhyāditi śeṣaḥṣaḍaṅgāni prati nyāsaṃ vidhāya pīṭhanyāsaṃ samācaretnamaḥ iti || 129dharmaṃ jñānaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ vairāgyaṃ kramato nyasetnaṅpūrvāṇi ca tānyeva dharmādīni yathākramamkeśarān karṇikāñcaiva patreṣu pīṭhanāyikāḥnandinī nārasiṃhī ca vaiṣṇavītyaṣṭanāyikāḥanaiśvaryāya namaḥ dakṣapārśve avairāgyāya namaḥ itinamaḥ iti | hṛdayāmbujasya patreṣu pīṭhanāyikā nyasetnamaḥ nārasiṃhyai namaḥ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ itidalāgreṣu nyasedetān prāṇāyāmaṃ tataścarethṛdi hastau samādhāya dhyāyeddevīṃ sanātanīmarūpaṃ tava yaddhyānamavāṅmanasagocaramagamyaṃ yogibhirgamyaṃ kṛcchrairbahuśamādibhiḥprāṇāyāmañcaretsanātanīmādyantaśūnyāṃ devīṃ dhyāyetkarmaṇi lyuṭādiryeṣāṃ te śamādayaḥ | bahavaśca te śamādayaḥ taiḥsūkṣmadhyānaprabodhāya sthūladhyānaṃ vadāmi teguṇakriyānusāreṇa kriyate rūpakalpanāpūjayet parayā bhaktyā mānasairupacārakaiḥmanasa iti | śīghramiti pūrvānvayi

sanskrit: bravīṣītyata āha arūpāyā ityādivikāsitamānanavaraṃ mukhaśreṣṭaṃ yasyāḥ tathābhūtāmparayā bhaktyā mānasairupacārakairdevīṃ pūjayetpādyaṃ caraṇayordadyāt manastvarghyaṃ nivedayetākāśatattvaṃ vasanaṃ gandhantu gandhatattvakamtejastattvantu dīpārthe naivedyañca sudhāmbudhimnṛtyamindriyakarmāṇi cāñcalyaṃ manasastathāamāyamanahaṅkāramarāgamamadaṃ tathāamātsaryamalobhañca daśa puṣpaṃ prakīrtitamevamagre'pyanvayaḥteneti | tenāmṛtena sahasrāracyutenasudhāmbudhimamṛtasamudram || 145caturthaṃ puṣpamiti pañcadaśaiḥ puṣpairbhāvarūpaiḥ prapūjayetmudrārāśiṃ subhaktañca ghṛtāktaṃ pāyasaṃ tathākāmakrodhau vighnakṛtau valiṃ dattvā japaṃ caretmālā varṇamayī proktā kuṇḍalīsūtrayantritāevaṃ daśa puṣpaṃ prakīrtitambhāvāḥ karmaṇyac | tadrūpaiḥ bhāvyamānairityarthaḥghṛtamiśritamstryaṅgaviśeṣadhāvanāmbhaḥmālā'bhyantarajape proktāakārādilakārāntamanuloma iti smṛtaḥviloma iti vikhyātaḥ kṣakāro merurucyateevamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā'nena samarpayet

sanskrit: gṛhāṇāntarjapaṃ mātarādye kāli namo'stu teityantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā bahiḥpūjāṃ samārabhetparameśvari svāheti evameva japet | jape'yamanuloma iti smṛtaḥiti vikhyātaḥ | kṣakāro mālāyā merurucyateito'nantarameva vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇayasyāḥ tathābhūte || 156yasya sthāpanamātreṇa devatā suprasīdatibhairavā api nṛtyanti prītyā siddhiṃ dadatyapimāyāgarbhaṃ trikoṇañca vṛttañca caturasrakamṅentāmādhāraśaktiñca namaḥśabdāvasānikāmmaṃ vahnimaṇḍalaṃ ṅentaṃ daśakalātmane tataḥastreṇa sthāpayettatra ādhāropari sādhakaḥviśeṣārghyasyeti | tatra bahiḥpūjāsamārambhe || 158nama iti mantreṇādhāraśaktimarcayedityarthaḥ || 160namo'ntena yajet pātraṃ mūlenaiva prapūrayetgandhapuṣpe tatra dattvā pūjayedamunā'mbikeṣoḍaśānte kalāśabdādātmane nama ityapisthāpayet || 162mūlenaiva mantreṇā'rghyapātraṃ prapūrayetvakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa tatraiva śaśimaṇḍalaṃ pūjayetṣoḍaśakalātmane nama iti mantraḥ śaśimaṇḍalārcane jātaḥdūrvāpuṣpaṃ sākṣatañca kṛtvā tatra nidhāpayetpūjayet gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ mūlaṃ dvādaśadhā japettadambu prokṣaṇīpātre kiñcinnikṣipya sādhakaḥpūjāsamāptiparyantamarghyapātraṃ na cālayet

sanskrit: tameva mantramāha tryambakaṃ yajāmaha itisthitamandhānāmagocaraṃ sūryamiva || 211satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamiti śaṅgaraśāsanammahādevyai samarpaṇeviśiṣya kathyatāṃ nātha yadi te'sti kṛpā mayisaiva nānāvidhā proktā tālakharjūrasambhavābahudheyaṃ samākhyātā praśastā devatārcanenātra jātivibhedo'sti śodhitā sarvasiddhidāśrīdevyuvāca yattvayetyādidarśayannāha tālakharjūretyādi | iyaṃ surā || 2yeneti | āhṛtā ānītā | atra surāviṣayetat sarvaṃ devatāprītyai bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥyadyadātmapriyaṃ dravyaṃ tattadiṣṭāya kalpayetstrīpaśurna ca hantavyastatra śāmbhavaśāsanātte'pi devyai pradātavyā yadi suṣṭhu vibharjitāḥyavagodhūmajaṃ vā'pi ghṛtapakvaṃ manoramambharjitānyanyabījāni adhamā parikīrtitābhraṣṭadhānyādisambhavā lājādi || 9sudhādāne devatāyai saṃjñaiṣāṃ śuddhirīritāniṣphalaṃ jāyate devi devatā na prasīdaticirarogī bhavenmantrī svalpāyurmriyate'cirātsvakīyā kevalā jñeyā sarvadoṣavivarjitākathitaṃ tatpratinidhau kusīdaṃ parikīrtitamnaiva dadyānmahādevyai dattvā vai nārakī bhavetmāṃsādīnāṃ śuddhiriti saṃjñā īritā kathitā

sanskrit: vinā hetudānam surāsamarpaṇamkālamatītyasvakīyā ātmīyā śaktiḥkusumapratinidhau | kusīdam raktacandanamnarakagāmitvamāha aśodhitānītyādināabhiṣiñcet kāraṇena sāmānyārghyodakena vānamaḥśabdāvasāne ca imāṃ śaktimudīrayetpavitrīkuruśabdānte mama śaktiṃ kuru dviṭhaḥśaktayo'nyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ nā'rhyāstāḍanakarmaṇivṛttaṃ ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya caturasraṃ likhedvahiḥśaktimiti śeṣaḥ | kāraṇena surayājātaḥ || 18svīyābhinnāḥ tāḍanakarmaṇi maithunakarmaṇitato'pi bahiścaturasraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ likhetnijanāmādibījāḍhyaṃ pūjayet sādhakottamaḥmāyāmādhāraśaktiñca namo'ntena prapūjayetvṛttopari yajedvahneḥ kalāḥ svasvādimākṣaraiḥkāmarūpaṃ pūjayedityarthaḥādhāradevatāṃ pūjayetsuśrīḥ surūpā kapilā havyakavyavahā tathāsacaturthīnamo'ntena pūjyā vahneḥ kalā daśaavasāne namo dattvā pūjayedvahnimaṇḍalamkabhādivarṇabījena ṭhaḍāntena prapūjayetsudhūmrā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamānamaḥ iti mantreṇādhāre vahnimaṇḍalamarcayedityarthaḥ

sanskrit: nāmamantreṇa prapūjayetnamo'ntenā'rghyapātre tu pūjayet sūryamaṇḍalamtribhāgaṃ pūrayenmantrī kalaśasthena hetunāsacaturthīnamo'ntena kalāḥ somasya ṣoḍaśasūryamaṇḍalaṃ pūjayethetunā surayā'rghyapātrasya tribhāgaṃ pūrayetpūṛṇā pūrṇāmṛtā kāmadāyinyaḥ śaśinaḥ kalāḥnamo'ntena yajenmantrī pūrvavat somamaṇḍalammāyayā prakṣipet pātre tīrthamāvāhayedapipūrṇāmṛtāṃ pūjayeditipātre prakṣipet tatraiva tīrthamapyāvāhayetdhenvā caivāmṛtīkṛtya chādayenmatsyamudrayāakhaṇḍādyaiḥ pañcamantrairmantrayettadanantaramsvacchandasphuraṇāmatra nidhehi kularūpiṇiamṛtatvaṃ nidhehyasmin vastuni klinnarūpiṇisudhātoyaṃ mantrayet mantritaṃ kuryātvisphūrtiṃ nidhehi sthāpaya | guṇe rāge drave rasa ityamaraḥsthāpayabhūtvā kulāmṛtākāraṃ mayi visphuraṇaṃ kuruāpūritaṃ mahāpātraṃ pīyūṣarasamāvahaparāhantāmaye vahnau homasvīkāralakṣaṇamvibhāvya pūjayeddhūpadīpāvapi ca darśayetvisphūrtiṃ kurusambhavo yatra tathābhūtaṃ pīyūṣarasamāvahā'nayajuhuyādityarthaḥ

sanskrit: kurvīran bhairavīcakrāttattvacakrādṛte śivetathā'dāne ca pāne ca varṇabhedo na vidyatetatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kṛpayā vaktumarhasiviśeṣapūjāsamaye tatkāryaṃ sādhakottamaiḥyathāsamayamāsādya kuryāccakramidaṃ śubhamārādhitā yena devī tūrṇaṃ yacchati vāñchitamaśanam bhojanam | ṛte vināubhayatra bhairavīcakre tattvacakre caśrīdevyuvāca kimidamityāditatkulapūjāvidhāvuktaṃ cakrānuṣṭhānam || 153yacchati dadātikāmādyenāstrabījena saṃśodhyopaviśettataḥtrikoṇañcaturasrañca maṇḍalaṃ racayet sudhīḥphalapallavasaṃyuktaṃ sindūratilakānvitampraṇavena tu saṃsthāpya dhūpadīpau pradarśayetsaṃkṣepapūjāvidhinā tatra pūjāṃ samācaretgurvādinavapātrāṇāṃ nātra sthāpanamiṣyatetadvahiścaturasrañcatuṣkoṇañca maṇḍalaṃ racayetsādhako dhūpadīpau taṃ pradarśayet || 158samācaret kuryāt || 160prokṣayedastramantreṇa divyadṛṣṭyā'valokayetānandabhairavīṃ devīṃ ānandabhairavaṃ tathācāruhāsāmṛtābhāṣollasadvadanapaṅkajāmvicitravasanāṃ dhyāyet varābhayakarāmbujāmityānandamayīṃ dhyātvā smaredānandabhairavam

sanskrit: prokṣayet jalena siñcet divyadṛṣṭyā'valokayeccadevaṃ vicintayetdakṣeṇa śuddhiguṭikāṃ dadhataṃ smarāmisaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ śodhayet kāraṇaṃ tataḥaṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā japan hetuṃ viśodhayetādyatattvapratinidhau vidheyaṃ madhuratrayamcintayāmiśodhayetkulārcako hetuṃ madyaṃ viśodhayet || 169alirūpamidaṃ mattvā devatāyai nivedayettadrūpeṇa na jānanti śaktiṃ sāmānyabuddhayaḥdhyānaṃ devyāḥ padāmbhoje sveṣṭamantrajapastathāpratyekaṃ śatadhā'nena manunā cābhimantrayetnivedya pūrvavat kālyai pānabhojanamācaret| idaṃ madhurayatramśaktiṃ striyamvidheyam tathā sveṣṭamantrasya japo vidheyaḥsvāheti manunā'bhimantrayet śodhayedityarthaḥpūrvavadeva pānabhojanamācarettavāgre kathitaṃ bhadre sārātsāraṃ parātparamsarvathā sādhakendreṇa kartavyaḥ śaivavartmanāparastrīgāmināṃ pāpaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥnivṛtte bhairavīcakre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthakcakramadhyagatā vīrā mama rūpā narākhyayāyena kenā'hṛtaṃ dravyaṃ cakre'smin viniyojayet

sanskrit: vīreṇa paśunā vāpi cakramadhyagataṃ śucibibhītāste palāyante vīrāṇāṃ brahmatejasāidantvityādi || 176pariṇayam vivāham || 178atra bhairavīcakreśrutvātra bhairavīcakraṃ dūraṃ gacchanti sādhvasamsendrāmaragaṇāḥ sarve tatrāgacchanti sādaramtridaśā yatra vāñchanti tava naivedyamuttamamāmaṃ pakvaṃ yadānītaṃ vīrahastārpitaṃ śucimucyante paśupāśebhyaḥ kalikalmaṣadūṣitāḥsarvatra sarvadā vīraḥ sādhayet kulasādhanamniṣṭhīvanamadhovāyuṃ varṇabhedaṃ vivarjayetnindakān kulaśāstrāṇāṃ cakrāddūrataraṃ tyajetkuladharmāt paribhraṣṭo vīro'pi narakaṃ vrajetsādhvasaṃ sabhayaṃtatra cakrasthāne || 185kuladharmāśritā ye vai pūjyāste devavat sadāsa yāti ghoranirayamapi vedāntapāragaḥsākṣācchivasvarūpāṇāṃ pāpaśaṅkā bhavet kutaḥtāvattu śāmbhavācārāṃścareyuḥ śivaśāsanātlokayātrāprasiddhyarthaṃ kuryuḥ karma pṛthak pṛthakcakramadhye sakṛt japtvā tat phalaṃ labhate sudhīḥsakṛdetat prakurvāṇaḥ sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyatenityaṃ samācaran martyo brahmanirvāṇamāpnuyātcareyuḥ kuryuḥ || 196

sanskrit: muṇḍāsanāt citāsanācca yat phalaṃ labhate || 198ihāmutra sukhāvāptyai kulamārgo hi nāparaḥgopanāt kuladharmasya kaulo'pi nārakī bhavettattvacakraṃ kuleśāni sāmprataṃ vacmi tat śṛṇunātrādhikāraḥ sarveṣāṃ brahmajñān sādhakān vināśuddhāntaḥkaraṇāḥ śāntāḥ sarvaprāṇihite ratāḥsatyasaṅkalpakā brāhmāsta evātrā'dhikāriṇaḥteṣāṃ tattvavidāṃ puṃsāṃ tattvacakre'dhikāritāyeṣāmutpadyate devi ta eva tattvacakriṇaḥatra cakrarāje tattvacakreśāntāḥ rāgadveṣādiśūnyāḥbhāvo bhāvanā vicintanetyarthaḥsarvatra brahmabhāvena sādhayet tattvasādhanambrahmajñaiḥ sādhakaiḥ sārddhaṃ tattvacakraṃ samārabhetvicitrāsanamānīya kalpayedvimalāsanamāsādayettu tattvāni sthāpayedagrataḥ śivesarvatattveṣu cakreśa imaṃ mantramudīrayetbrahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinātattvasādhanam tattvacakrasādhanam || 209atha tattvacakrasya vidhānamāha ramye ityādibhiḥmantramudīrayetmantramevāha brahmārpaṇamitip. 212) saptadhā vā tridhā japtvā tāni sarvāṇi śodhayetbrahmajñaiḥ sādhakaiḥ sārddhaṃ vidadhyāt pānabhojanamna deśakālaniyamo na pātraniyamastathā

sanskrit: kulabhedaṃ varṇabhedaṃ te gacchantyadhamāṃ gatimtattvacakramanuṣṭheyaṃ dharmakāmārthamuktayesaṃnyāsavihitāt dharmān kṛpayā vaktumarhasividhinā yena kartavyastat sarvaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratamtāni madyādīni śodhayetbrāhmeṇa manunā o/ saccidekaṃ brahmeti mantreṇagṛhasthānāmityādividhānam sāmpratamidānīmadhyātmavidyānipuṇaḥ saṃnyāsāśramamāśrayettyaktvā'samarthān bandhūṃśca pravrajannārakī bhavetkulāvadhūtasaṃskāre pañcānāmadhikāritānirmamo nilayādgacchenniṣkāmo vijitendriyaḥprītyā'numatimanvicchet gṛhājjigamiṣurjanaḥgrāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nirapekṣo gṛhādiyātkulāvadhūtaṃ brahmajñaṃ gatvā saṃprārthayedidamgṛhādiviṣayamamatāśūnyaḥ nilayāt gṛhātanumatimanvicchet anujñāmādadyātnirapekṣaḥ niṣpṛhaḥ | iyāt gacchetparamānandanirvṛttaḥ paramānande nimagnaḥprasādaṃ kuru me nātha saṃnyāsagrahaṇaṃ pratiśāntaṃ vivekinaṃ vīkṣya dvitīyāśramamādiśetṛṇatrayavimuktyarthaṃ devarṣīnarcayet pitṝnṛṣayaḥ sanakādyāśca devabrahmarṣayastathāatra ye pitaraḥ pūjyā vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tānapimātāmahādayo'pyevaṃ mātāmahyādayo'pi ca

sanskrit: yat prārthayet tadāha gṛhāśrame ityādināśāntam uparatacittamdevān ṛṣīn pitṝścārcayet pūjayetdevarṣayo nāradādayo brahmarṣayo bhṛgvādayaśca pūjyāḥatra saṃnyāsakarmaṇipramātāmahīvṛddhapramātāmahyośca grahaṇammātāmahān pratīcyāñca pūjayennyāsakarmaṇidevādīn kramatastatrā'vāhya pūjāṃ samācaretkṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prārthayet pitṛdevatāḥguṇātītapade yūyamanṛṇīkurutā'cirātṛṇatrayavinirmukta ātmaśrāddhaṃ prakalpayetmātāmahānmātāmahaprabhṛtīn yajet pūjayetkuryātyūyamanṛṇī kūruta || 238ātmanyātmārpaṇārthāya kuryādātmakriyāṃ sudhīḥāvāhyā'tmapitṝn devi dadyāt piṇḍaṃ samarcayanpiṇḍārthamāstareddarbhānudagagrān svakarmaṇiyuyukṣuścittaśuddhyarthamimaṃ mantraṃ śataṃ japetūrvārukamiva bandhanān mṛtyormukṣīya mā'mṛtātsaṃsthāpya kalaśaṃ tatra guruḥ pūjāṃ samārabhetātmakriyāṃ kuryāttathābhūtān darbhānāstaret || 242tameva mantramāha hrī/ tryambakamityādikamśiṣyasyeṣṭadevatāyāḥ pūjāṃ guruḥ samārabhetvidhāya pūjāṃ brahmajño vahnisthāpanamācaret

sanskrit: śūdrāṇāmitareṣāñca śikhāṃ hutvaiva saṃskriyāgururutthāpya taṃ śiṣyaṃ dakṣakarṇe vadedidamnirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ svabhāvena sukhaṃ carabrahmamayo brahmasvarūpaḥvarṇasaṅkarāṇām || 262ahamityasyāderlopastvārṣaḥātmasvarūpaṃ taṃ matvā praṇamecchirasā guruḥtvameva tat tattvameva viśvarūpa namo'stu tesvamantreṇa śikhācchedāt saṃnyāsagrahaṇaṃ bhavetsvecchācāraparāṇāṃ tu pratyavāyo na vidyateviharet svecchayā śiṣyaḥ sākṣād brahmamayo bhuvivismarannāmarūpāṇi dhyāyannātmānamātmaniśirasā praṇametnamastubhyamityādikamsaṃnyāsagrahaṇaṃ bhavetbrahmajñānetyādinirdvandvastatsvarūpaḥnirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ saṃnyāsī viharet kṣitausukhaduḥkhasamo dhīro jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥsadānandaḥ śuciḥ śānto nirapekṣo nirākulaḥvigatāmarṣabhīrdānto niḥsaṅkalpo nirudyamaḥśītavātātapasahaḥ samo mānāpamānayoḥkvacidapyanāsaktaḥspṛhā yasya saḥnirākulaḥ ākulatāśūnyaḥ

sanskrit: svadehanirvāhārthavyāpāraśūnyaḥmānāpamānayorapi samaḥ harṣaviṣādaśūnya ityarthaḥnistraiguṇyo nirvikalpo nirlobhaḥ syādasañcayīātmāśritastathā deho jānannevaṃ sukhī bhavetātmā sākṣī vinirlipto jñātvaivaṃ mokṣabhāg bhavetretastyāgamasūyāñca saṃnyāsī parivarjayetsarvaṃ brahmeti jānīyāt parivrāṭ sarvakarmasudeśaṃ kālaṃ tathā pātramaśnīyādavicārayantattadvastusañcayābhāvavāneva dehaḥ pratiṣṭhati evaṃ jānan saṃnyāsī sukhī bhavetjñātvaiva saṃnyāsī mokṣabhāg bhavetavadhūto nayet kālaṃ svecchācāraparāyaṇaḥsampūjya gandhapuṣpādyairnikhanedvāpsu majjayetsvabhāvājjāyate devi pravṛttiḥ karmasaṅkuleśreyastadeva jānantu yatraiva dṛḍhaniścayāḥnāmarūpaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tadarthaṃ kalpitaṃ mayākurvan kalpaśataṃ karma na bhavenmuktibhāg janaḥsākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ matvā gṛhasthastaṃ prapūjayettattvavicāraṇaiḥ brahmatattvavivecanaiḥjaleṣukarmasamūheanurāgavantaḥ | tadeva arcādikarmaivatīrthavratatapodānasarvayajñaphalaṃ labhetsaṃskārān sarvavarṇānāṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mamanāsaṃskṛto'dhikārī syād daive paitre ca karmaṇi

sanskrit: kartavyā sarvathā yatnairihāmutra hitepsubhiḥcūḍopanayanodvāhāḥ saṃskārāḥ kathitā daśasantītyāha jīvaseka ityādinā sārddhadvayenateṣāṃ navaiva saṃskārā dvijātīnāṃ daśa smṛtāḥkāmyānyapi varārohe kuryācchāmbhavavartmanāpuraiva brahmarūpeṇa tānyuktāni mayā priyeviprādivarṇabhedena kramānmantrāśca darśitāḥpraṇavādyāṃstu tān mantrān prayogeṣu niyojayetmāyādyaiḥ sarvakarmāṇi kuryuḥ śaṅkaraśāsanātsarve mantrā mayaivoktāḥ prayogo yugabhedataḥteṣāṃ hitāya kalyāṇi kuladharmo nirūpitaḥsaṃskārādikriyāsteṣāṃ saṃkṣepeṇāpi vacmi tebrāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānām || 5tasmādādau pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tāṃ devavanditehastamātrapramāṇena sthaṇḍilaṃ racayet sudhīḥkūrcenābhyukṣya tāḥ sarvā vahninā vahnimāharetānīya vahniṃ tatpārśve sthāpayedvāgbhavaṃ smaranhrī/ kravyādebhyo namaḥ svāhā kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajetuddhṛtya tāsu rekhāsu māyādyāṃ vyāhṛtiṃ smarantām kuśaṇḍikāmvahnimāharet ānayetsan tatpārśve sthaṇḍilasya pārśve sthāpayetdiśi parityajetsvakarmavihitaṃ nāma kṛtvā dhyāyeddhanañjayamajārūḍhaṃ śaktidharaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam

sanskrit: dhyātvaivaṃ prāñjalirbhūtvā'vāhayeddhavyavāhanamadhvaraṃ rakṣa rakṣeti namaḥ svāhā tato vadetdhyāyet || 19tathābhūtamnamaḥ svāheti mantro jātaḥyathopacāraiḥ sampūjya sapta jihvāḥ prapūjayetlelāyamāneti ca sapta jihvāḥuttarāntaṃ maheśāni tridhā prokṣaṇamācarettridhā paryukṣaṇaṃ kuryāttato yajñīyavastunaḥjihvāḥ prapūjayetsaptajihvāḥprokṣaṇamācarettridhaiva paryukṣaṇaṃ kuryātudaksaṃsthairuttarāgraiḥ prāgagrairanyadiksthitaiḥvāmāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kalpitāsanātityuktvāgnerdakṣiṇasyāṃ nikṣipedutkarādināsīdāmīti vadan brahmā viśettatrottarāmukhaḥsampūjya gandhapuṣpādyairbrahmāṇaṃ prārthayedidammāñca yajñapatiṃ pāhi karmasākṣinnamo'stu teprāgagrairdarbhaiḥ kuśaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ paristaredācchādayetkuśapatramagnerdakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi nikṣipet || 29viśettamevedaṃ prārthayetgopāya rakṣatatra darbhamayaṃ vipraṃ kalpayet yajñasiddhaye

sanskrit: tadā'bhiṣiktakaulena saṃskāraṃ sādhayet priyekhāntārṇaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ bījamasya prakīrtitamkartavyakarmaṇo vighnaśāntyarthe viniyogitāprāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhyāyed gaṇapatiṃ śivesaṃskāraṃ naraḥ sādhayetgakārarūpamakṣaram asya vighneśasya bījaṃ prakīrtitamiti ṛṣinyāsaṃ vidadhyātmantreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā gaṇapatiṃ dhyāyettīvrā ca jvālinī nandā bhogadā kāmarūpiṇīpūrvādito'rcayitvaitāḥ pūjayet kamalāsanamtathābhūtamabhyarcya taccaturdikṣu gaṇeśaṃ gaṇanāyakamekadantaṃ raktatuṇḍaṃ lambodaragajānanaumahodarañca vikaṭaṃ dhūmrābhaṃ vighnanāśanamteṣāmastrāṇi sampūjya vighnarājaṃ visarjayetbhojayecca pañcatattvairbrahmajñān kulasādhakānvākyena vighnarājaṃ visarjayetvidhinā adhivāsanamācaret kuryātutsṛjet kaulatṛptyarthaṃ bhojyañcaikamapi priyearcayitvā mātṛgaṇān vasudhārāṃ prakalpayettato gatvā guroḥ pārśvaṃ praṇamya prārthayedidamtvatpādāmbhoruhachāyāṃ dehi mūrdhni kṛpānidhenirvighnaṃ karmaṇaḥ siddhimupaimi tvatprasādataḥmanorathamayī siddhirjāyatāṃ śivaśāsanātāyurlakṣmīvalārogyāvāptyai saṅkalpamācaret

sanskrit: kāraṇaiḥ śuddhisahitairabhyarcya vṛṇuyād gurumcitradhvajapatākābhiḥ phalapallavaśobhiteghṛtapradīpāvalibhistamoleśavivarjitevyajanaiścāmarairbarhairdarpaṇādyairalaṅkṛteracayenmṛṇmayīṃ tatra cūrṇairakṣatasambhavaiḥkariṣye iti saṅkalpamācaret kuryātvastrādibhirvṛṇuyātcitradhvajapatākābhiśca śobhitemaṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ vidadyāt śrīgurustataḥkṛtvā pūrvoktamantreṇa pañcatattvāni śodhayetsvārṇaṃ vā rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ ghaṭameva vāsthāpayedbrahmabījena sindūreṇā'ṅkayet śriyāmūlamantratrijāpena pūrayet kāraṇena tamnavaratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā ghaṭamadhye viniḥkṣipetśyāmalairharidvarṇaiḥ || 137pūrvoktamantreṇa madyādīni pañcatattvāni śodhayetsindūreṇā'ṅkayecca || 140pallavaṃ tanmukhe dadyāt vāgbhavena kṛpānidhiḥrāmāṃ māyāṃ samuccārya sthāpayet pallavopariśaktau raktaṃ śive viṣṇau śvetavāsaḥ prakīrtitamniḥkṣipya pañcatattvāni navapātrāṇi vinyasetśrīpātrantu mahāśaṅkhaṃ tāmrāṇyanyāni kalpayetghaṭamadhye navaratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā viniḥkṣipet || 142tanmukhe ghaṭamukhe | vāgbhavena aimiti mantreṇasthāpayet
